jobs.title: Senior Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
The Organic World is India’s largest retailer of organic and natural groceries and a leading Responsible Retailer, dedicated to enabling better choices and sustainable value. As the flagship brand of the NIMIDA Group, the company focuses on offering worry-free groceries that benefit customers, local communities, partner farms and brands, and the planet. With 2000+ products across categories such as organic produce, chemical-free staples, toxin-free home and personal care, natural wellness, and healthier snack alternatives, The Organic World aims to cover everyday household needs. Since its pilot store in 2017, the brand has grown to 30+ stores across Bengaluru, Mysuru, Coimbatore, and Hyderabad, supported by a revamped e-commerce platform. Its industry-first “Not In Our Aisle List” bans 25+ potentially harmful ingredients, ensuring that only products meeting stricter standards are offered to customers.

**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for leading and overseeing all quality assurance and quality control activities across The Organic World’s product range and retail operations. This role involves developing and maintaining quality standards, policies, and procedures aligned with the “Not In Our Aisle List” and regulatory requirements, and ensuring consistent implementation across stores, warehouses, and supplier networks. The Senior Quality Manager will manage vendor audits, product testing, and certifications, as well as monitor compliance with organic, natural, and safety guidelines. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing and approving new products, investigating quality issues and customer complaints, coordinating corrective and preventive actions, and preparing quality reports for leadership. The role also includes mentoring quality teams, collaborating with procurement, operations, and merchandising, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to elevate product safety and customer trust.

Head Quality, Regulatory & Organic Compliance

The Organic World / Wellbe Foods

Roles & Responsibilities

Regulatory Compliance

FSSAI

* Ensure full compliance with all applicable
  FSSAI regulations
  across retail stores, warehouses, CMUs, and food manufacturing units.
* Manage
  FSSAI licenses and registrations
  for new locations, renewals, modifications, and business expansions.
* Prepare and submit
  annual returns, regulatory filings, and statutory documentation
  within timelines.
* Coordinate and ensure successful closure of
  FSSAI inspections, audits, and regulatory observations
  .
* Drive compliance readiness across operations and ensure adherence to food safety standards.

Organic Certification & APEDA

* Ensure compliance with
  APEDA-NPOP organic certification requirements
  across The Organic World and Wellbe Foods operations.
* Coordinate certification, surveillance, and renewal audits with certification bodies.
* Maintain organic product traceability, documentation, and segregation controls.
* Ensure compliance with organic sourcing, labeling, storage, transportation, and processing requirements.
* Lead successful closure of all internal and external organic audits.

Quality Assurance & Food Safety

* Develop, implement, and monitor Quality Management Systems (QMS) across stores, warehouses, CMUs, and manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure compliance with
  HACCP, FSMS, ISO 22000, GMP, GHP, and food safety standards
  .
* Monitor adherence to production quality parameters, in-process controls, and finished product specifications.
* Establish and maintain product traceability and recall management systems.
* Drive implementation of SOPs, CAPA, quality standards, and product specifications for all private-label products.
* Oversee raw material, packaging material, in-process, and finished goods quality inspections.
* Conduct supplier, warehouse, retail, and manufacturing audits and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Investigate customer complaints, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions.
* Approve or reject non-conforming materials/products and ensure effective corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Operations, Category, and NPD teams during product development and commercialization.
* Drive quality performance metrics, process improvements, and wastage reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance of
  Fresh Fruits & Vegetables, Dairy, Grocery, and Organic products
  as per FSSAI and APEDA norms.
* Review laboratory reports, analytical test results, and microbiological reports to ensure product safety and compliance.
* Lead and mentor quality teams across multiple business locations.

Candidate Profile

* Master's Degree in
  Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, or related disciplines
  .
* 12–15 years of experience in
  Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Affairs, and Organic Compliance
  within Retail, FMCG, Food Manufacturing, Dairy, Fresh Produce, or Organic Food sectors.
* Strong knowledge of
  FSSAI, APEDA-NPOP Organic Standards, HACCP, FSMS, ISO 22000, GMP, GHP, and Food Safety Regulations
  .
* Experience managing regulatory audits, organic certifications, vendor quality assurance, and supply chain compliance.
* Strong exposure to retail and private-label quality management.
* Proven experience in audit management, stakeholder management, vendor development, and cross-functional leadership.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and team management skills.
* Ability to lead quality, compliance, and regulatory functions across multiple locations and business units.

Preferred:
Experience in Organic Food Retail,Fruits & Vegetables Fresh Produce, Dairy, FMCG, or Omnichannel Food Businesses.

jobs.title: Manager III, Software Development, Emerging Device Software
jobs.description:
**Description**
Are you a software development leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and delivering software systems that make a real difference for customers? At Amazon, you will lead a team of talented engineers, owning the technical vision and strategic direction for software products that operate at massive scale. You will define roadmaps, shape architecture decisions, and guide your team through complex, ambiguous problems—turning customer needs into reliable, well-crafted solutions. This role offers the opportunity to influence organizational goals, mentor future leaders, and drive meaningful innovation while growing your own career alongside some of the most talented technologists in the industry.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and grow a software development team, establishing team structure and strategic direction while coaching engineers and developing future leaders through collaborative development planning and project assignment.
* Own the technical vision, charter, and 1–2 year roadmap for your team's software systems, partnering with stakeholders to prioritize projects that align with organizational goals and customer needs.
* Drive system design decisions by facilitating and contributing to architectural discussions, evaluating tradeoffs across scalability, maintainability, performance, and security to deliver high-quality, sustainable software.
* Create operational mechanisms and metrics that provide visibility into team performance, software health, and customer experience, taking action to address risks and improve outcomes proactively.
* Collaborate across teams and functions to align on priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive solutions, while communicating ideas effectively through written narratives and strategic documents.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning might begin reviewing operational dashboards and connecting with engineers on an active design review. By midday, you could be partnering with product and peer teams to align on quarterly priorities or unblocking a cross-team dependency. Afternoons often shift to one-on-one coaching sessions with your direct reports, working through career development plans or providing feedback on technical proposals. You will balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving, staying connected to the details while keeping the bigger picture in focus.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team is committed to building High Quality Consumer Electronics products that customers rely on every day. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and an inclusive environment where every voice contributes to better outcomes. We are focused on simplifying complex systems, investing in engineering excellence, and empowering each team member to take ownership of meaningful work. If you are excited about leading a team that tackles hard problems, ships quality software at scale, and constantly raises the bar, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of engineering experience
* 5+ years of engineering team management experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience developing and managing a high-performing team
* Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience working cross-functionally with a wide breadth of stakeholders, users, engineers, and leaders to generate buy-in
* Experience with capacity planning and delivery estimation using team velocity metrics

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Experience designing and launching new products from the ground up
* Knowledge of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and networking
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey technical status to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience in hiring, mentoring and growing new engineers
* Experience with C++, C, Android System Software development
* Ability to quickly ramp up on the essentials of new technical areas

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Corporate Chef | Senior Executive Chef, F&B Operations**

**Experience:**
8–12+ Years

**Preferred Candidates From:**
ITC, Rebel Foods, EatClub (BOX8), Hyperpure Kitchens, Swish, QSR chains, large restaurant groups, etc.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, On-site | Bengaluru

**Budget:**
12-18LPA

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Chef to lead culinary operations across our growing restaurant business.

The role will be responsible for maintaining food quality and consistency across outlets, managing central kitchen operations, developing and implementing kitchen SOPs, controlling food costs, and building efficient kitchen teams.

We are looking for someone who understands both the culinary and commercial aspects of running a multi-outlet F&B business and can build scalable kitchen operations without compromising on taste or quality.

**What You'll Work On**

- Overseeing culinary operations across central kitchen and restaurant outlets.

- Maintaining consistency in taste, presentation, portion sizes and food quality.

- Developing and implementing standardised recipes, kitchen SOPs and operating processes.

- Managing menu execution, product quality and new product introductions.

- Optimising kitchen workflows, preparation processes and manpower requirements.

- Managing food costs, wastage, yields, inventory and kitchen productivity.

- Training and developing kitchen teams, chefs and outlet kitchen managers.

- Coordinating with procurement and supply chain teams on ingredients, vendors and product quality.

- Conducting regular kitchen audits and identifying operational improvements.

- Ensuring food safety, hygiene and statutory compliance across all kitchen operations.

**What We're Looking For**

- Proven experience as a Corporate Chef, Executive Chef, Head Chef or Culinary Operations Head.

- 8–12+ years of experience in restaurant operations, QSRs, multi-outlet food businesses or central kitchen environments.

- Strong expertise in Indian vegetarian cuisine, particularly North Indian food, gravies, dals, tandoori products, chaap, kebabs and Indian breads.

- Experience managing multiple kitchens, central kitchens or large-scale food production operations.

- Strong understanding of recipe standardisation, food costing, portion control, yield management and inventory management.

- Experience developing kitchen SOPs and implementing processes across multiple outlets.

- Ability to train, manage and build high-performing kitchen teams.

- Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, quality control and FSSAI requirements.

- Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and improve kitchen productivity without compromising food quality.

- Commercial mindset with a strong understanding of food costs, labour costs, wastage and outlet-level profitability.

- Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

**How We'll Measure Success**

- Consistency of food quality and taste across all outlets.

- Food cost performance against agreed targets.

- Reduction in food wastage and preparation inefficiencies.

- Improved kitchen productivity and manpower utilisation.

- Successful implementation and adoption of kitchen SOPs.

- Central kitchen and outlet operational efficiency.

- Kitchen team performance, training and retention.

- Reduction in customer complaints related to food quality and consistency.

- Successful execution of menu launches and product improvements.

**Who Should Apply?**

Someone who has successfully managed culinary operations at scale and understands how to build systems around food.

You should be equally comfortable developing a dish, troubleshooting a kitchen operation, analysing food costs, training a team and ensuring that the same dish tastes identical across multiple outlets.

**The goal is simple: Build a kitchen operation that can scale without compromising the food.**

jobs.title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

jobs.description:
**Company Description:**
**MedInno Technologies Private Limited (“MedInno”)**
is a molecular-diagnostics venture build-out funded by Menterra, a private equity advisory firm whose equity funds support companies in Healthcare, Agriculture, and Education.

MedInno was founded to deliver early, accurate, and frugal diagnosis to improve survival rates in underserved populations through its products and services.

MedInno has anchored its portfolio around the RT-PCR platform, focusing on disease areas where mortality can be prevented and/or long-term disease management enabled through appropriate care, and where disparities in healthcare outcomes between urban and rural populations can be minimized through timely diagnosis and treatment. We have accordingly identified TB, HPV (Cervical Cancer), Anaemia, Sickle Cell Disease, Beta Thalassemia, Hepatitis (B & C), and HIV as core areas of focus in Phase-1.

MedInno is at various stages of developing diagnostic solutions across this portfolio and is looking for a qualified Senior Scientist to join its R&D facility in Mahadevapura, Whitefield, Bangalore.

**Role Description:**
The Senior Scientist will independently own, plan and execute the end-to-end development of molecular IVD kits and devices, spanning nucleic acid extraction and real-time PCR technologies, with hands-on responsibility and accountability for delivering validated, reproducible, regulatorily acceptable and commercially manufacturable products within product availability timelines set by the Company. The role encompasses the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation, feasibility, assay design, formulation and optimisation through analytical and clinical validation, regulatory approvals, manufacturing transfer and post-launch support. The individual will independently plan and execute experiments, secure materials and resources, and investigate and resolve technical and performance-related issues. A key expectation is to minimise development iterations, rework and delays through rigorous upfront planning and experimental design, without compromising product performance, quality or regulatory compliance.

The individual will work closely with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing and Commercial teams to ensure successful regulatory evaluations, manufacturing scale-up and commercial deployment. This includes establishing manufacturing process parameters, quality specifications, acceptance criteria, stability and shelf-life data, ensuring lot-to-lot consistency, maintaining complete and traceable scientific and technical documentation in accordance with ISO 13485 and applicable CDSCO requirements, and leading scientific and technical engagements with regulatory authorities and external evaluation laboratories. As part of the senior scientific team, the individual will drive cost optimisation, indigenisation of raw materials and components, improvement of manufacturing yields and qualification of alternatives without compromising product performance or compliance. The role will also contribute to MedInno's intellectual property strategy and lead the scientific and technical authorship of grant proposals, peer-reviewed publications and conference submissions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong background in diagnostics R&D, including assay development, validation, and optimization for clinical diagnostics with demonstrated experience in developing at least 2 RTPCR kits end to end.
* Knowledge of device development processes, including integration of assays into hardware platforms and collaboration with engineering teams.
* Familiarity with quality and regulatory standards in diagnostics (e.g., ISO, GLP, validation and verification best practices).
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects, mentor team members, and work effectively in cross-functional, collaborative environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing technical documentation, reports, and scientific publications and experience representing both products and the Company to regulatory bodies during audits and reviews
* Master’s or PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related life science/engineering discipline.
* This is an in-person full time position, applicants must be based out of Bangalore or willing to relocate

**ABOUT US**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**JOB IN SUMMARY**

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems.

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls.

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Global Food Safety COE Deployment**

* Act as the Asia Pacific representative of the Global Food Safety COE.
* Support implementation of global food safety strategies, standards and initiatives across all Asia Pacific sites.
* Drive alignment and harmonization of microbiological risk management programs across regions.
* Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes.
* Participate in global communities of practice and technical working groups.

**Microbiological Risk Management**

* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for food microbiology and microbiological risk management.
* Lead microbiological risk assessments for products, ingredients, processes and manufacturing environments.
* Identify current and emerging microbiological risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Support the development of preventive food safety controls using scientific and risk-based approaches.
* Provide technical leadership during significant food safety incidents and investigations.

**Environmental Monitoring Programs**

* Lead deployment and continuous improvement of environmental monitoring programs across Asia Pacific.
* Establish risk-based pathogen and indicator organism monitoring strategies.
* Support sites in trend analysis, program optimization and investigation of environmental positives.
* Drive standardization of environmental monitoring methodologies across the region.
* Provide technical guidance for environmental monitoring program design and governance.

**Thermal Process Validation Program**

* Own and lead the validation program for thermal kill steps across all relevant manufacturing sites within Asia Pacific.
* Develop validation standards, protocols and scientific methodologies aligned with global requirements.
* Review and approve thermal process validation studies and challenge testing activities.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering teams to ensure validated processes are maintained and controlled.
* Support revalidation following process, product or equipment changes.
* Drive consistency of thermal process validation approaches across product platforms and regions.
* Maintain oversight of thermal validation effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Validation & Verification**

* Provide technical leadership for food safety validation and verification programs.
* Support validation of preventive controls, sanitation programs and microbiological interventions.
* Review validation protocols and ensure scientific rigor in study design and interpretation.
* Support implementation of risk-based verification activities across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs.

**Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead microbiological investigations associated with food safety incidents, environmental positives and customer complaints.
* Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement.
* Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities.

**Capability Building & Training**

* Develop and deliver advanced food microbiology and food safety training programs.
* Build microbiological capability across regional and site Quality & Food Safety teams.
* Coach and mentor food safety professionals across the region.
* Support development of technical competency frameworks for food safety and microbiology disciplines.
* Drive knowledge sharing through communities of practice and technical forums.
* Conduct Good Laboratory Practice internal audits for Micro Labs in the region
* Review new test methods and support implementation at all Micro Labs.
* Introduce rapid validated methods to improve TAT for microbiology tests at internal labs.
* Guide & Coordinate the Proficiency test program for all Micro Labs in the region.

**Regulatory, Customer & Audit Support**

* Participate in customer specifications review, understand requirements for RTE products, and provide guidance to sites on implementation.

* Monitor emerging scientific developments and evolving regulatory requirements.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATION**

* PhD in Microbiology is required.
* Additional qualifications in Food Science, Food Technology, Biotechnology or related disciplines are advantageous.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in food microbiology, food safety or food manufacturing environments.
* Advanced expertise in foodborne pathogens, environmental microbiology, thermal processing and microbiological risk assessment.

jobs.title: Statutory Accountant [T500-31075]
jobs.description:
**About ADM:**

We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.

**About ADM India Hub:**

At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.

At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.

**Job Title:**
Statutory Accountant

**Type/ Location:**
Full time,
Bangalore, India

**About ADM**
:

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over.

**The Role:**

The Statutory Reporting team is responsible for the preparation and audit of financial statements of over 150 of ADM subsidiaries, worldwide.

Statutory Reporting is part of the Corporate Finance department of ADM and is responsible for the completeness and correctness of ADM’s accounting and external financial reporting under Local GAAP and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

In this position, you will not only prepare financial statements, but also leverage your expertise in IFRS, local GAAPs, and technical accounting to manage financial reporting for multiple entities. You will also engage in cross-functional projects, contribute to automation initiatives, and gain exposure to high-impact areas.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Prepare Financial Statements:**
  Support the preparation of financial statements under IFRS and other GAAPs of ADM subsidiaries, ensuring accurate identification and adjustment of differences between USGAAP and IFRS/local GAAPs.
* **Local Regulatory Compliance:**
  To Support tax, company secretary and other regulatory compliance activities.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with external and internal stakeholders including Tax, Treasury, and Controlling, providing exposure to diverse areas of financial management.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Support the automation and standardization of financial statement preparation, in accordance with ADM's strategy to streamline processes, improve efficiency and ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Tackle Complexity:**
  Dive into complex topics like hyperinflation accounting, business combinations under common control and consolidation, providing expertise and solutions.
* **Technical Analysis:**
  Assisting with research and prepare technical memorandums to address scenarios to support the rationale and accounting treatment for relevant topics.

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field such as Finance, Accounting or Auditing is preferred
* Qualified/Semi-qualified accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA) with at least 3 to 5 years of experience in preparing and/ or auditing financial statements.
* Big 4 company experience is a plus
* Deep professional experience including application of IFRS accounting - any other GAAP is a plus.
* Able to articulate financial positions with excellent communication skills.
* Assertive and able to work both independently and within a global team.
* Fluent in spoken and written English is a must (other languages being a plus).
* Excellent in MS Excel, knowledge of accounting-related functionalities in an ERP System preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
jobs.description:
**Description**
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
  
  

* Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
* Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
* Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
* Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
* Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
* Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
* Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
* Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
* Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

**About The Team**
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
  
  
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
* Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
* Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
* Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
* Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
* Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
* Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
* Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI - Karnataka

jobs.description:
**Ninjacart**
-
**Pioneer. Challenge Yourself. Create Better Lives**

Ninjacart is India’s largest multi-category, multi-channel fresh produce fulfillment platform, working to make fresh produce agriculture more predictable and dependable.

Our mission is to reduce food wastage, bridge information gaps in agricultural trade, and connect reliable sellers with trusted buyers. Over the last 10 years, we’ve built India-focused technology and solutions that are transforming how fruits and vegetables move from farms to consumers’ plates every day.

Today, we’ve served 200,000+ farmers, 60,000+ retailers and 5,000+ traders. For example, we can move 300 tons of fresh produce from hundreds of farms to 20,000+ stores in just 14 hours.

We’re backed by Walmart, Flipkart, Tiger Global, Accel and Syngenta, with a team of 1,000+ employees. We’ve also been recognised among LinkedIn’s Top 25 Startups to Work For and received the “Best Tech for Agriculture” award at the India Digital Enabler Awards 2025.

We’re now expanding beyond India through Ninja Global, with operations growing into Malaysia and Europe. Our ambition is to build a global network for fresh fruits and vegetables and become a global leader in fresh produce commerce over the next 10 years.

Our Ninja CODE is built around four values: Customer Obsession, Ownership Mindset, Dream Big & Bold Responsibility, and Relentless Innovation.

**About the Role**

Ninjacart is looking for a detail-oriented professional with experience in fruit import operations, import documentation, and shipment coordination. The ideal candidate should have a working knowledge of cross-border payments, purchase and sales order processing, and import compliance, along with the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external logistics partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Import Shipment Management: Coordinate and track fruit import shipments, ensuring timely execution and smooth operational flow.
* Documentation & Compliance: Manage import documentation and ensure the accuracy of shipment-related records and compliance requirements.
* Order & Invoice Processing: Handle purchase orders (PO), sales orders (SO), and invoice creation.
* Cross-Border Payments: Coordinate import-related payment processes with the finance team and relevant stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with internal supply, demand, and finance teams, as well as freight forwarders and shipping lines.
* Team Coordination: Support and guide the import operations team, assign operational tasks, and ensure timely completion.
* Operational Reporting: Prepare shipment tracking reports and operational dashboards, highlighting delays, documentation gaps, and potential risks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in fruit import operations or the import industry.
* Working knowledge of import shipment management and documentation.
* Experience with PO/SO processing and invoice creation.
* Understanding of cross-border payment processes.
* Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to prepare operational reports and track shipments effectively.
* Proficiency in Hindi and English.

jobs.title: Dairy Nutritionist
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**

The Dairy Nutritionist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize dairy feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve ruminant performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key dairy nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Formulate and optimize dairy feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality in alignment with quality team, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and performance standards.
* Analyse performance data and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Formulation, R&D and global team to develop new ingredients.
* Collaborate with cluster marketing specialists to understand emerging nutritional requirement of cluster and develop right nutritional strategy for that cluster.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum 8 years of experience in dairy nutrition, feed formulation and dairy industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of dairy nutritional requirements and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives and dairy critical nutrients.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Ph.D. (Animal Nutrition).
* Experience in commercial dairy operations or feed industry.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. Compliance teams work closely with Business, Product, Legal, Tech, Risk, and Audit functions to provide expertise on regulatory compliance matters, assess and measure compliance risks, and monitor and test the adequacy of the firm's compliance environment.
  
  
Lines of Business Relevant to This Role
  
  
Merchant Solutions
  
  
PhonePe offers a comprehensive suite of solutions for its 37 million merchant partners to enable end-to-end control over their entire payment process, including transaction confirmation and reconciliation:
  
  

* SmartSpeakers: Provides instant voice payment alerts in noisy environments alongside host operational features.
* PhonePe Payment Gateway (PG): Delivers best-in-class online payment experiences to consumers and digital merchants.
* Point-of-Sale (POS) Devices: Empowers offline merchants to effortlessly accept payments via Debit Cards, Credit Cards, and UPI with seamless settlement processes.

Payments
  
  
PhonePe enables users to send and receive money, recharge mobile, FASTag, & DTH, make bill payments (electricity, credit card bills, rent payments, LPG), make donations, and pay for purchases at stores. Users can also pay for financial services such as loan repayments and tax payments.
  
  

* Core Payment Products: Prepaid Payment Instruments (Wallet & EGVs), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), and Bharat Bill Pay Operating Unit (BBPOU).

At PhonePe, we empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Building for scale, rapid iterative development, and customer-centric product thinking define every single day. While we engineer for a 500M+ user base with speed, we care utmost for security, stability, regulatory compliance, and automation. The candidate will serve as a trusted regulatory advisor to senior leadership, driving a proactive compliance posture across the PhonePe ecosystem.

+ Lead and manage all regulatory inspections and audits conducted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and other regulatory bodies.

jobs.description:

Olyv (formerly SmartCoin) is an AI-powered fintech platform focused on making financial services more accessible and inclusive. Through digital lending, digital gold savings, credit health and financial wellness solutions, Olyv empowers individuals, micro-entrepreneurs and small businesses with convenient financial solutions.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to strengthen our regulatory compliance framework and support business operations across digital lending, payment services and other financial products.
  
  
The role involves interpreting regulatory requirements, advising business and support teams, managing regulatory changes and ensuring effective implementation of compliance practices across products, partnerships and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Change Management
* Monitor applicable RBI directions, NPCI guidelines, FIU-IND requirements and other relevant regulatory developments.
* Assess the impact of regulatory changes and coordinate with business and support functions to define implementation plans.
* Track compliance actions, responsibilities and timelines to ensure timely implementation.
* Product and Partner Advisory
* Review new products, lender partnerships, customer journeys across Olyv applications and partner platforms, including co-lending arrangements.
* Evaluate customer disclosures, marketing communications and significant process changes from a regulatory compliance perspective.
* Document compliance requirements and escalate unresolved regulatory risks before product or process launches.
* Policies and Procedures
* Draft, review and update compliance policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational checklists.
* Ensure alignment with applicable requirements relating to digital lending, BBPS, UPI, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), outsourcing, collections and grievance redressal.
* Regulatory Reporting and Inspections
* Maintain and monitor the regulatory obligations and compliance calendar.
* Coordinate documentation, supporting evidence and draft responses for regulatory filings, supervisory queries and inspections.
* Ensure regulatory submissions are appropriately reviewed and routed through the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO).
* Compliance Oversight and Training
* Prepare compliance updates and reports for the Board and senior management.
* Develop and conduct compliance awareness and training programmes for sales and support teams.
* Coordinate with Product, Risk, IT, Finance and Operations teams to monitor and close corrective action plans.
* Agreements and Business Arrangements
* Review business arrangements, partnership agreements and contractual documentation for regulatory compliance.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure necessary modifications and ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualification**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS).
* LL.B. qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in an NBFC, fintech or financial services organisation.

**Technical Skills And Expertise**

* Working knowledge of RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI and NPCI regulations and guidelines applicable to NBFCs, BBPS and UPI.
* Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
* Strong understanding of regulatory interpretation, compliance documentation and policy drafting.
* Ability to assess regulatory risks and translate requirements into actionable compliance measures.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to consumer lending and digital lending journeys.
* Experience handling Lending Service Provider (LSP) arrangements and lender partnerships.
* Familiarity with supervisory reviews, regulatory inspections and lender-partner compliance assessments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and regulatory interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

Posha builds cooking robots that live inside your kitchen and cook food for you completely autonomously. Posha uses Artificial Intelligence enabled Computer Vision to consistently and reliably cook the best food for our users 🥘

*why*
a recipe works, want to make a machine cook as well as a skilled chef, and are ready to own problems end to end.

**Working at Posha**
🚀

* A 60-sec overview video about us
* What users have to say about our Product

This role is responsible for turning business questions into structured analyses, meaningful metrics, measurable KPIs, actionable insights, and decision- ready recommendations. It contributes to team and business goals by identifying opportunities, testing hypotheses, and enabling stakeholders to act on reliable, well-explained data. The role also helps determine how a problem should be solved using data, whether through reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or advanced data science methods.

* Collaborate with business, product, operations, engineering, and data teams to improve data quality, instrumentation, analytical workflows, and action tracking.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* Experience in data analysis, business analysis, business intelligence/reporting, or techno-functional analytics roles.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, advanced Excel, and one BI platform such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with Jupyter notebooks, GCP, and BigQuery.
* Proven experience in exploratory data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, data validation, and several of the following: statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, segmentation, cohort analysis, predictive modelling, time-series forecasting, or experimentation design.
* Experience partnering with stakeholders to frame business questions, define KPIs and success metrics, and translate findings into practical actions.
* Experience working cross-functionally and translating business needs into analytical or technical deliverables.

**Skills:**

* Working knowledge of statistical and analytical libraries such as scikit-learn and statsmodels for basic modelling and analysis.
* Functional expertise in problem structuring, metric design, root-cause analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal reasoning.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain methods, assumptions, and recommendations clearly to non- technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, data-quality discipline, and comfort working independently in ambiguous environments.

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2,200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U.S customers each week.

We build and shape technology solutions that solve customers’ problems every day, making things easier for them when they shop with us online or in a store. We have made bold, strategic moves to migrate and modernize our core foundational capabilities, positioning ourselves as the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company in the industry.

Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging.

**About Albertsons Companies India:**

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company’s technology journey to support millions of customers’ lives every day.

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being.

**Analytics - Business Analyst**

**Role Summary:**

This role is responsible for turning business questions into structured analyses, meaningful metrics, measurable KPIs, actionable insights, and decision- ready recommendations. The role combines traditional analytics, statistical methods, and business translation to improve planning, performance, and process decisions across the function. It contributes to team and business goals by identifying opportunities, testing hypotheses, and enabling stakeholders to act on reliable, well-explained data. The role also helps determine how a problem should be solved using data, whether through reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or advanced data science methods.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end analytical problem solving by translating business questions into hypotheses, analysis plans, and decision-ready recommendations.
* Assess business problems and determine the right data approach, including reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or data science.
* Own KPI design, metric definitions, dashboards, reports, and recurring insight packs that improve visibility into business performance.
* Analyze large structured and semi-structured datasets using SQL, Python, Excel, and BI tools to identify trends, risks, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities.
* Apply statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, segmentation, cohort analysis, and experimentation design to evaluate initiatives and quantify impact.
* Design and assess A/B tests, interpret statistical and practical significance, and communicate business implications clearly.
* Support basic predictive analysis and time-series forecasting where relevant, including simple model development, validation, and scenario analysis.
* Collaborate with business, product, operations, engineering, and data teams to improve data quality, instrumentation, analytical workflows, and action tracking.
* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and well documented through validation checks, notebook discipline, version control, and clear metric logic.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* Experience in data analysis, business analysis, business intelligence/reporting, or techno-functional analytics roles.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, advanced Excel, and one BI platform such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with Jupyter notebooks, GCP, and BigQuery.
* Proven experience in exploratory data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, data validation, and several of the following: statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, segmentation, cohort analysis, predictive modelling, time-series forecasting, or experimentation design.
* Experience partnering with stakeholders to frame business questions, define KPIs and success metrics, and translate findings into practical actions.
* Experience working cross-functionally and translating business needs into analytical or technical deliverables.

**Skills:**

* Strong technical skills in SQL, Python, Excel, data wrangling, dashboarding, statistical methods, data visualization, and basic ML workflows.
* Working knowledge of statistical and analytical libraries such as scikit-learn and stats models for basic modelling and analysis.
* Functional expertise in problem structuring, metric design, root-cause analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal reasoning.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain methods, assumptions, and recommendations clearly to non- technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, data-quality discipline, and comfort working independently in ambiguous environments.

**AI Skills (Mandatory):**

* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools for daily engineering tasks to enhance productivity, optimize effort, and ensure cost-aware AI assistance.
* Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including semantic layers for data retrieval and grounding Large Language Model (LLM) responses.
* Conceptual understanding of LLM-based applications (e.g., chatbots, Q&A systems), encompassing prompt engineering, context management, and response generation.
* Exposure to agentic and multi-agent AI systems, including agent roles, tool utilization, memory management, and workflow orchestration.
* [Good to have] Practical experience with LLM application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or Google GenAI tools) for prototyping and integrating AI-driven solutions.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with Git-based workflows, reusable notebook practices, and collaboration with data science or ML teams.
* Exposure to advanced analytics techniques such as forecasting, causal inference, or uplift measurement.
* Domain experience in retail, grocery, e-commerce, operations, pricing, supply chain, marketing, or customer analytics.

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist
jobs.description:
Cellink, part of BICO Group, is dedicated to Creating the Future of Health by leveraging the power of 3D cell culture through award-winning 3D bioprinters and carefully sourced biomaterials and bioinks. BICO is a lab automation partner and provider of selected workflows to pharma and biotech, with 46,000+ instruments installed in over 65 countries. BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world's top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 12,000 publications. Operating through two business areas: Lab Automation and Life Science Solutions - BICO strives toward enabling and automating the life science lab of the future. BICO is listed on Mid-Cap, Nasdaq Stockholm under BICO.

They are looking for a
**Field Application Specialist**
who is pivotal in providing technical and application support during both the pre- and post-sales process. You will provide technical support and expertise to customers regarding the application and use of Cellink's products in the field, collaborating with clients to ensure effective implementation, training, and ongoing support, ultimately driving customer satisfaction and product utilization.

This is a full-time position.
**Employment will be managed through WorkMotion**
, acting as the direct employer to handle your local contract, payroll, and benefits. This role is based in Bangalore, with an expectation of traveling up to 75% of the time to customer sites for training, troubleshooting, and relationship management.

**Key responsibilities**

* Technical Support: Provide on-site and remote technical assistance to customers, addressing product-related questions and troubleshooting issues.
* Training and Education: Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers to enhance their understanding of product features and applications.
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, helping customers with scientific questions to achieve their research objectives and experiments in a contract research setting.
* Product Demonstrations: Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations to prospective and existing customers, showcasing the capabilities and advantages of the solutions.
* Feedback Collection: Gather and document customer feedback on product performance and application, relaying insights to the product development team for improvements.
* Market and Product Knowledge: Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, industry trends, and competitive landscape to effectively address customer inquiries.
* Reporting: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, training sessions, and support activities in the CRM system, and prepare reports on customer feedback and product usage.

**Candidate requirements**

* Education: At least a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Technical Background: Strong background in cell-based assays, particularly 3D cell culture assay.
* Scientific Knowledge: Understanding of cell biology, 3D modelling, biomaterials, tissue engineering and regeneration.
* Lab Experience: Lab experience in cell culture, microscopy, and biochemical assays.
* Experience: 3+ years of experience in a technical support or application specialist role, preferably within a scientific, medical, or engineering environment.
* Communication Skills: Excellent technical writing and public speaking skills.
* Customer-Facing Experience: Prior customer-facing experience preferred.
* Languages: Professional-level English is mandatory.

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience with 3D printing preferred.

**Benefits and perks**

* Compensation: INR 1,200,000-1,700,000 a year (gross)
* Private Health Insurance

jobs.title: QA Compliance Lead Auditor (Host)
jobs.description:
This position is within Fortrea’s Global Quality Assurance organization, responsible for providing regulatory expertise, hosting complex GCP audits and inspections, and driving global quality initiatives. This position serves as a regulatory subject matter expert (SME), supporting internal teams, clients, and regulatory authority interactions to ensure ongoing compliance and inspection readiness.
  
  
The role contributes to global QA policy development, leads and/or supports audit/inspection hosting and response activities, leads quality metrics reporting, and participates in continuous improvement initiatives across the QA organization. The position also acts as a backup to QA Management and supports operational reporting responsibilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and host business development, sponsor qualification, routine sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and for-cause audit activities, including scheduling, agendas, request lists, SME coordination, and preparation of audit/inspection support materials.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, sponsors, inspectors, internal stakeholders, and operational teams throughout the audit or inspection lifecycle.
* Support operational team readiness before, during, and after external audits and inspections, including preparation meetings, document collection, interview coordination, and issue escalation.
* Facilitate audit and inspection activities as host, support, or coordinator, ensuring requested documentation, systems access, and subject matter experts are available in accordance with applicable procedures.
* Manage receipt, triage, review, and internal routing of external audit reports, including coordination of stakeholder review, finding assessment, response ownership, and timelines.
* Review and challenge external audit responses, corrective actions, and CAPAs to ensure they are adequate, complete, clearly supported, aligned with procedural expectations, and responsive to the reported observations.
* Track external audit commitments, responses, CAPAs, evidence, and follow-up actions to support timely completion, closure, and appropriate escalation of overdue or quality-critical items.
* Support regulatory inspection readiness and for-cause audit coordination by compiling requested information, maintaining audit/inspection records, and providing status updates to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
* Assist with cross-training, mentoring, coaching, and/or supervision of auditors, audit hosts, or audit support staff as required.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge through continuing education, review of relevant guidance and publications, and participation in professional networks as appropriate; contribute to team objectives and perform other duties as assigned.
* Contribute to the development and interpretation of global QA policies related to regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits as directed, such as process/system and service provider quality assessment for qualification/requalification
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline. Relevant and equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Fluent in English, written and verbal.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in a regulated environment, including GxP roles.
* Demonstrated regulatory expertise with detailed knowledge of GCP and applicable global regulations.
* Experienced Lead GCP Auditor with strong critical thinking and risk-based assessment skills.
* Strong strategic communication skills with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Experience leading or contributing to quality and process improvement initiatives reducing inspection risks and strengthen inspection readiness.

**Preferred Qualifications Include**

* Postgraduate degree (MSc or equivalent) in a scientific or management‑related discipline.

**Work Environment**

* Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.
