jobs.title: SR Risk Manager, Social Responsibility - Human Rights, Sustainability, GPO
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon’s mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need to develop leaders who represent, and can innovate, on behalf of a diverse and demanding global customer base. The Global Procurement Organization (GPO) identifies and procures goods and services at the best value for business, maintaining the quality of products and ensuring that alternative sources of supply are available. The Social Responsibility (SR) and Human Rights program drives customer trust and business continuity by ensuring respect for the rights of workers throughout Amazon’s supply chain and operations. We uphold company standards and expectations (such as Amazon's Supply Chain Standards and Human Rights Principles), and seek to constantly improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.
  
  
As an SR Risk Manager in SR Ops, within the Global Procurement Sustainability (GPS) team, you will work closely with Amazon’s Social Responsibility team and the Global Procurement Organization to implement mechanisms to meet Amazon’s human rights principles and Supply Chain Standards and to ensure our suppliers are compliant with those.
  
  
You will be responsible for Audit risk assessment activities across Global Operations suppliers and remediation plan coordination. You will work closely with internal and external partners to plan and execute high-quality and impactful audits, which address the highest human right risks.
  
  
You will insist on the highest standards for your audits and you will be able to dive deep into every audit area, apply broad technical knowledge, sound business judgment, and partner with key stakeholders.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work across GPO, collaborating with external partners (Audit companies) and internal business partners, such as Operations, WW SR and Sustainability, Legal and Risk Management to identify and assess regulatory and human rights compliance risks as it relates to our supplier baseline
* Review new and existing suppliers (legacy) ensuring that they meet Human Rights compliance, safety, terms of service standards, investigate suspicious suppliers / driver activity and behaviors that could pose a risk to Amazon, our customers, or others
* Drive cross-functional assessments of risks and controls to align to company strategy and risk appetite. Be able to assess the real situation sometimes with limited information in hand in order to make an independent decision about the suppliers’ integrity and compliance standards
* Be responsible for site-level/ supplier remediation of high-severity issues identified in assessments, or external sources (i.e., whistle-blower, media alerts, worker voice)
* Assist with creation of investigation plans to determine root cause, and leads the remediation efforts with CSR while maintaining communication with leadership and impacted stakeholders
* Coordinate and plan remediation activities for suppliers in case of high-risk findings
* Handle day-to-day issues (constantly thinking about how to invent and simplify to improve)
* Manage business docs/XBRs

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 5+ years of supply chain experience
* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
* 2+ years of experience in compliance, audit or risk management
* Business communication skill in English and Hindi

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) Law

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Compliance Testing – Manager

Through technology, data analytics and AI-driven solutions, Olyv provides digital financial services, including credit, digital gold savings and financial wellness solutions.
  
  
At Olyv, we are committed to building a stronger financial ecosystem by making financial services more accessible, transparent and convenient.

You will work with business, risk, legal and technology teams to identify control gaps, test adherence and track issues through to closure.

+ Compliance Risk AssessmentConduct compliance risk assessments across business functions, products and processes.
+ Map applicable regulatory requirements (RBI, Companies Act and other applicable laws) to internal policies and controls.

+ Control TestingDesign and execute the compliance testing plan and test procedures.

jobs.description:
Company: Glasafe
  
Location: Bangalore
  
Department: Product Development & Procurement
  
Experience: 5–10 years preferred
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About Glasafe
  
  
Glasafe is a fast-growing Indian consumer brand specializing in premium borosilicate glassware, drinkware, food storage containers, and innovative kitchen and lifestyle products.
  
We are looking for a commercially driven and resourceful professional who can lead new product discovery, global supplier sourcing, product development, and procurement activities.
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring international markets, discovering innovative products, working directly with factories, and converting ideas into commercially successful products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. New Product Research & Development – 30%
  
  
\* Continuously research Indian and international markets to identify emerging product trends, innovations, and new launch opportunities.
  
\* Study competitor products, customer preferences, pricing, product features, and market gaps.
  
\* Identify products with strong potential for the Indian D2C, e-commerce, quick-commerce, and retail markets.
  
\* Develop new product concepts in coordination with the internal design, marketing, and management teams.
  
\* Work directly with manufacturers to customize product designs, materials, features, packaging, and functionality.
  
\* Evaluate product feasibility, target selling prices, manufacturing costs, and potential profitability.
  
\* Maintain an active pipeline of new product ideas and launch opportunities.
  
  
2. Global Vendor Identification & Sourcing – 30%
  
  
\* Identify and develop reliable manufacturers across China, India, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand, and other global manufacturing markets.
  
\* Independently research factories through sourcing platforms, industry networks, trade exhibitions, and direct outreach.
  
\* Evaluate manufacturers based on production capabilities, quality standards, pricing, innovation, and reliability.
  
\* Develop relationships with OEM and ODM manufacturers for customized product development.
  
\* Negotiate factory prices, MOQs, tooling costs, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
  
\* Identify alternative manufacturers to reduce sourcing costs and supplier dependency.
  
\* Explore opportunities for domestic manufacturing, component sourcing, and local assembly.
  
  
3. Product Sampling & Commercialization – 20%
  
  
\* Coordinate product sampling from initial concept to final approved sample.
  
\* Work with factories and the internal design team on product modifications and improvements.
  
\* Evaluate samples for quality, functionality, durability, finish, and commercial viability.
  
\* Coordinate prototype development, mould modifications, packaging, and branding requirements.
  
\* Compare supplier quotations and prepare detailed product cost sheets.
  
\* Ensure timely development and approval of samples.
  
\* Coordinate with internal teams to transition approved products into bulk production.
  
  
4. Import Management & Procurement – 20%
  
  
\* Handle international procurement and coordinate import-related activities.
  
\* Understand import costing, including FOB, CIF, freight, customs duties, IGST, clearing charges, and inland transportation.
  
\* Prepare accurate landed-cost calculations for imported products.
  
\* Understand Incoterms, HS codes, import documentation, and applicable Indian customs regulations.
  
\* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and overseas suppliers.
  
\* Track purchase orders, production schedules, shipments, and delivery timelines.
  
\* Negotiate procurement terms and optimize total landed costs.
  
\* Ensure smooth coordination between suppliers, logistics partners, and internal operations.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
\* 5–10 years of experience in new product development, international sourcing, vendor development, or procurement.
  
\* Strong experience sourcing products directly from overseas manufacturers, particularly China.
  
\* Proven ability to identify new products and take them from concept through sampling to commercial production.
  
\* Experience working with OEM/ODM factories and customized product development.
  
\* Strong negotiation skills with a good understanding of manufacturing costs and supplier economics.
  
\* Working knowledge of international trade, customs duties, Incoterms, and import costing.
  
\* Ability to independently research suppliers, compare quotations, and prepare commercial feasibility reports.
  
\* Strong Excel, analytical, communication, and vendor-management skills.
  
\* Willingness to travel internationally for factory visits, supplier development, and trade exhibitions.
  
  
Preferred Industry Experience
  
  
Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
  
  
\* Kitchenware, glassware, and houseware
  
\* Drinkware, food storage, and lifestyle products
  
\* Consumer durables and home products
  
\* D2C consumer brands
  
\* Import-oriented trading and sourcing companies
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be measured through:
  
  
1. Number of commercially viable new product opportunities identified.
  
2. Number of new manufacturers and suppliers developed.
  
3. Number of new products successfully sampled and launched.
  
4. Product development timelines from concept to approved sample.
  
5. Cost savings achieved through sourcing, negotiation, and product engineering.
  
6. Quality, reliability, and competitiveness of suppliers.
  
7. Accuracy of landed-cost calculations and timely import coordination.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
We are looking for a product hunter and developer, not just a purchase-order manager.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be curious about new products, proactive in discovering manufacturers, commercially sharp in negotiations, and capable of independently driving product development.
  
  
They should be comfortable working directly with overseas factories, challenging existing product designs, finding better manufacturing solutions, and bringing innovative, competitively priced products to the Indian market.
  
  
Role Focus: 80% New Product Development, Global Sourcing & Vendor Development | 20% Procurement & Import Management.

jobs.description:
**About The Role**
You will own critical retailer-commerce journeys on Kirana Club, from product discovery and decision-making to checkout and repeat purchase. Your first and most important mandate will be to improve retailer activation—moving retailers from their first to fourth delivered order. This is an ambiguous, cross-functional problem spanning product experience, assortment, pricing, trust, fulfilment and user behaviour. You will be expected to identify where the real constraint lies, determine what product should solve, and build solutions that materially improve the business outcome.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the product roadmap for retailer activation, with an immediate focus on first-order conversion and progression from the first to fourth delivered order.

* Diagnose funnel and behavioural problems through data, user research and market visits rather than starting with predetermined features.
* Build and test solutions across discovery, product comprehension, cart, checkout, assisted buying, post-order and repeat journeys.
* Work closely with Growth, Design, Engineering, Data, Supply and Fulfilment, while distinguishing product problems from pricing, assortment and operational problems.
* Define success metrics, make clear product trade-offs and measure impact on delivered orders and repeat behaviour—not only clicks or feature adoption.
* Build scalable product systems rather than relying primarily on notifications, discounts or manual interventions.

**What We're Looking For**

* 6–9 years of total experience, including at least 4–6 years in product management, preferably in consumer commerce, marketplaces, fintech, quick commerce or another transactional product.

* Has independently owned a meaningful conversion, activation, retention, monetisation or transactional-funnel metric.
* Strong first-principles problem solver who can structure an ambiguous problem before jumping to solutions.
* Comfortable combining behavioural data, qualitative research and commercial understanding.
* Has built or materially improved a zero-to-one consumer journey, not only optimised an established feature backlog.
* Strong execution in a resource-constrained environment and comfortable working directly with business and operating teams.
* AI-native in research, analysis, prototyping and day-to-day product execution.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Builder, SAP Concur Spend
jobs.description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
We are looking for a product professional who can operate in a new paradigm where AI is foundational to how products are discovered, designed, built, and delivered.
  
  
As a
**Product Builder for SAP Concur Spend**
, you will play a key role in shaping the next generation of AI-native spend management experiences. You will work at the intersection of customer insight, product strategy, experience design, and intelligent automation, translating real-world customer problems into scalable, commercially viable, and high-impact product capabilities.

You bring strong product management experience with end-to-end ownership of product discovery, roadmap development, delivery, and post-launch adoption. You have practical experience designing AI-native products and applying Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted product development techniques to solve real customer problems. You are comfortable independently identifying customer needs, challenging assumptions, validating hypotheses, and driving product decisions with minimal oversight. You possess a strong understanding of human-in-the-loop design, human-agent interactions, context engineering, and Responsible AI principles, and can apply these concepts to create effective and trustworthy user experiences. You have experience rapidly prototyping solutions using AI-assisted tools to visualize concepts, validate customer demand, and accelerate product discovery. You excel at customer engagement, market research, and competitive analysis, transforming insights into differentiated product experiences. You leverage data, experimentation, and meaningful success metrics to inform decisions and measure customer and business outcomes. You are skilled at prioritization, making build-versus-buy decisions, and defining product scope by balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and commercial viability. You are an effective collaborator and communicator who can influence stakeholders across cross-functional and global teams. Experience with spend management, expense management, finance systems, ERP platforms, or enterprise SaaS solutions is advantageous.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
You will independently own assigned product areas end-to-end, shaping and evolving the product roadmap to align customer needs, business priorities, and emerging AI-driven opportunities. You will identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, enable intelligent decision-making, and deliver differentiated AI-native experiences within SAP Concur Spend. jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
We build AI-first. Our engineers direct AI agents through most of the code they ship — planning with them, reviewing their output, and owning the result. If Claude Code, Cursor, or a similar agentic workflow isn't already central to how you work, this role won't be a fit. If it is, you'll feel at home on day one.

We're building agentic AI products that own entire workflows, not just answer questions. Our two products:
**Ozyn**
, an AI assistant that executes tasks across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets, and 50+ integrations — and
**Alvoff**
, a conversational procurement platform with agentic RAG and supplier intelligence serving buyers across 20+ industries. We practice what we build: our own development is AI-first, end to end.

**What you'll do**

You'll own features end-to-end across Ozyn and Alvoff: talk to users, scope the problem, build it, ship it, and watch how it lands. There are no handoffs between "product" and "engineering" here — you are both.

* Ship full-stack features with AI agents doing the bulk of implementation under your direction
* Talk directly to users and turn ambiguous problems into shipped product, often within days
* Set the bar for what AI-first development looks like — better prompts, better agent workflows, better review practices — and raise it as the tools evolve
* Make pragmatic calls on quality: knowing when agent output is good enough to ship and when it needs your hands on the keyboard
* Contribute to product direction, not just implementation. If you think we're building the wrong thing, we want to hear it

**How we work**

* **Agents write most of our code.**
  Your job is judgment: decomposing problems, directing agents, reviewing critically, and owning correctness. Typing speed is not the bottleneck; taste and decision speed are.
* **Small team, high ownership.**
  You'll ship to production in your first week.
* **Users over process.**
  We optimize for learning fast, not for ceremony.
* Open to candidates across India. The role is based in Bengaluru (on-site), and we welcome applicants from other cities who are open to relocating.

**What we're looking for**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals — you can evaluate and correct AI-generated code because you could have written it yourself
* A genuinely AI-native workflow today, not aspirationally. You have opinions about agent orchestration, context management, and where these tools break
* Product sense: you've shipped things users loved (or hated — and you learned why)
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You'd rather ship a v1 this week than a v3 next quarter
* 3+ years building production software, or a portfolio that makes years irrelevant

**Nice to have**

* Experience at an early-stage startup or as a founder
* You've built with LLM APIs (evals, agents, RAG) — useful, but note this role is about building
  *with*
  AI, and only sometimes building AI features
* Public evidence of how you work: repos, posts, tools you've built for yourself

jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience (GRAISE)
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
  
  
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
  
  
Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale
  
  
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
  
  
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
  
  
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
  
  
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
  
  
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, collaborating with engineers to deploy computer vision models to production, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
**About The Team**
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency

* 2+ years of solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms experience
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with large sets of data and deriving practical insights
* 2+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
* Experience developing and evaluating data annotation and data quality metrics
* Demonstrated ability to take a model from research prototype to production deployment — including performance profiling, latency optimization, and working within serving infrastructure constraints
* Track record of clearly documenting experiments, writing technical design documents, and communicating results to cross-functional partners

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Department: Quality Control

Job Purpose:  
To lead and manage overall Quality Control laboratory operations—covering raw material, in-process, intermediate, finished API, and stability testing—while ensuring 100% compliance with cGMP, GLP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and global regulatory standards (USFDA, EDQM, WHO, CDSCO).  
Key Responsibilities:

* Laboratory Operations: Direct end-to-end sampling, analytical testing, and timely release of Raw Materials (RM), Packing Materials (PM), In-Process samples, Intermediates, Finished APIs, and Water/Environment monitoring samples to meet production and dispatch schedules.
* Instrumentation & Calibration: Ensure timely qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, and preventive maintenance of analytical instruments including HPLC, GC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, ICP-OES, XRD, FTIR, UV, and Karl Fischer.
* Stability Management: Oversee the stability program (charging, pulling, testing, and trend evaluation) in accordance with ICH guidelines and regulatory filing commitments.
* Regulatory Audits & Compliance: Serve as the primary auditee for QC during regulatory inspections (USFDA, MHRA, EU-GMP, TGA, PMDA, WHO) and customer audits, ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Data Integrity & Computerized Systems: Enforce strict compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles across all standalone instruments, CDS (Empower/Chromeleon), and LIMS; oversee periodic audit trail reviews.
* QMS & Investigations: Lead root-cause investigations for Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and laboratory incidents; review and approve Deviations, Change Controls, and CAPAs.
* Method Transfer & Validation: Oversee Analytical Method Validation (AMV), Method Verification, and Analytical Method Transfer (AMT) from R&D/ADL to commercial QC.
* Documentation Control: Review and approve QC SOPs, Specifications, Standard Testing Procedures (STPs), and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs).
* Standards & Inventory Management: Manage qualification, storage, and inventory of reference/working standards, impurities, columns, and reagents.
* Team Leadership & Budgeting: Lead, mentor, and manage shift schedules for QC Managers and Analysts; prepare annual Capex/Opex budgets and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.

Qualifications & Experience:

* Education: M.Sc. (Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry / Organic Chemistry) or M.Pharm.
* Experience: 15–20+ years in Pharmaceutical Quality Control, with extensive experience in API / Bulk Drug manufacturing and at least 4–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Regulatory Exposure: Proven track record of successfully handling stringent regulatory audits (USFDA, EDQM, EU-GMP, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies:

* Expertise in chromatography (HPLC, GC), spectroscopy, and trace-level impurity analysis (nitrosamines, genotoxic impurities, elemental impurities).

**Organisation:** GCV Life Pvt. Ltd. (GCViDEAL)**Job Title:** Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation

**Job type:** On site

**Location:** Chakala, Mumbai

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

· Support product positioning through technical information, formulation inputs and product development insights.

G. Commercial strategy

· Identify, evaluate and develop strategic relationships with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Develop commercial strategies to generate business through manufacturing partners by leveraging GCV's product portfolio, proprietary ingredients, formulation capabilities and innovation pipeline.

· Identify opportunities to introduce GCV-developed formulations and ready-to-launch products into manufacturers' existing client networks and business portfolios.

· Engage with manufacturers to understand their existing capabilities, client base, market reach and potential business opportunities for GCV.

H. Cross-functional Coordination & Project Management

· Act as a central coordination point between business development and external vendors.

· Develop and monitor project timelines covering formulation, sampling, procurement, packaging, testing, manufacturing and dispatch.

· Conduct regular follow-ups with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project milestones.

· Identify project risks, operational bottlenecks and interdepartmental dependencies and drive resolution.

· Coordinate internal project reviews and development meetings.

· Ensure appropriate documentation, communication and accountability throughout the product development and supply lifecycle.

· Provide management with project updates, manufacturing status, supply risks and development progress.

**Requirements**

● B.Sc./ M.Sc. degree in food technology, biotechnology, microbi

jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

**Location:**

R&D & New Product Development

Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures, and recently featured on Shark Tank India. Every product we sell starts as a brief written here. This role owns that journey from idea to a product on the shelf: the formulation, the trials, the evidence behind the claims, and the partners who make it.

**Role Overview**

You'll own new product development and improvement of existing products across supplements, functional foods, and wellness, working through contract manufacturers, third-party formulators, and ingredient vendors. You'll work directly with the founders on what to build, with Regulatory & Compliance on claims and labels, with Procurement on ingredients and packaging, and with Brand, Design, and Growth on launch. The job rewards people who can combine scientific judgment with speed, cost discipline, and follow-through.

**What You'll Own**

**Concept to Formulation Brief**

• Turn product concepts and consumer insight into clear, testable briefs for formulators and manufacturing partners

• Research ingredients, formats, and dosages for new wellness and supplement products

• Benchmark competitor products across India and global markets on formulation, claims, pricing, and positioning

• Develop across formats: powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets, and others as the range grows

**Formulation & Product Trials**

• Own formulation development, from first sample to approved pilot batch

• Track every iteration — sensory trials, stability results, scale-up outcomes — and decide what moves forward and what is rejected

• Evaluate products on taste, mixability, texture, aroma, appearance, and usability

• Maintain structured documentation of trials, observations, and formulation changes

**Ingredient & Claims Research**

• Evaluate functional ingredients for dosage, evidence, usage restrictions, and clean-label suitability

• Build the claim substantiation file for each product — literature, references, and product rationale — before artwork is finalized

• Stay current on trends in women's health, gut health, protein, sleep and stress, and preventive wellness

**Vendor & Manufacturer Coordination**

• Coordinate with ingredient suppliers, contract manufacturers, and testing labs on samples, timelines, COAs, specifications, MOQs, and trial batches

• Support sourcing of ingredients and packaging components for new launches

• Compare vendors on quality, responsiveness, cost, and scalability, and give Procurement the technical input to negotiate

**Quality & Compliance Support**

• Own product specifications, ingredient sheets, and test reports for every product you develop

• Provide accurate label inputs, and work with Regulatory & Compliance on classification and claim alignment before launch

**Launch Readiness**

• Work with Brand, Design, Operations, and Growth so every product is ready on the launch date

• Translate technical product details into simple consumer-facing benefits

• Brief internal teams through launch decks, product notes, and FAQs

**Cost & Existing Product Improvement**

• Hold each formulation to a target cost of goods set at the brief stage, and flag early when a design choice puts it at risk

• Use consumer reviews, complaints, and operational feedback to prioritize improvements to existing products

• Use AI tools for literature and competitor research, verifying dosage, regulatory limits, and citations before anything is relied upon

• Education qualification - B Pharma, M Pharma, Pharmacognosy, Food technology

**What We're Looking For**

• 6–8 years of hands-on experience in NPD, R&D, or product development in supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods, or FMCG wellness - who can independently lead the development activities.

• Brand-side experience: has taken products from brief to commercial launch through contract manufacturers or third-party formulators at a D2C or consumer brand — not only in-house at a manufacturer

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

Key Responsibilities

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

Qualifications & Experience

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

* Salary Range is - 45000.00 - 70000.00

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Application Lab Senior Executive / Assistant Manager develops tests and demonstrates personal care and home care formulations that showcase the company's principals' ingredients. The role bridges suppliers, sales teams and customers, turning raw material know-how into practical formulations, technical data and compelling presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Skin Care Formulations

* Develop and optimise skin care prototypes – creams, lotions, serums, gels, sun care, cleansers and colour cosmetic bases – using the principals' emulsifiers, emollients, actives, UV filters, rheology modifiers, preservatives and sensory additives.
* Create benchmark and starting-point formulations that showcase ingredient performance, stability and sensory.
* Adapt customer formulas for ingredient substitution, cost optimisation, sustainability or regulatory change.
* Work on natural, vegan and clean beauty concepts in line with market trends.

2. Hair Care Formulations

* Develop shampoos, conditioners, masks, leave-on treatments, styling products, colorants and scalp-care formulations.
* Evaluate surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones and alternatives, and actives for claims such as anti-dandruff, repair, frizz control and colour protection.
* Run sulphate-free, silicone-free and bio-based formulation projects.

3. Home Care Support

* Support home care formulations (laundry, dishwash, surface and fabric care) as business needs require.

4. Testing and Performance Evaluation

* Test physico-chemical parameters: pH, viscosity, appearance, colour, odour, foam, SPF/UV and droplet size.
* Run stability (accelerated, freeze-thaw, light, centrifuge), compatibility and preservative efficacy studies, coordinating with external labs where needed.
* Conduct sensory panels and in-vitro/in-vivo claim support studies, including hair-tress and skin-feel evaluations.
* Maintain and calibrate lab instruments; ensure GLP, safety and housekeeping.

5. Innovation and Trend Monitoring

* Track global personal care trends, launches, regulations and competitor products; convert insights into concept formulations.
* Collaborate with principals on new ingredient launches and co-development projects.
* Propose new product concepts and sustainable, value-added solutions for the regional market.
* Capture market and consumer trends from market visits, customers, retail and competitor products; share insights and opportunity reports with sales, marketing and principals.

6. Trade Shows, Events and Customer Engagement

* Prepare and present formulations, samples and demo material at trade shows and conferences (e.g., in-cosmetics, HPCI, CHT, local exhibitions).
* Support technical seminars, lab tours and live application demonstrations.
* Support the sales team on customer visits, in person and virtual (video calls, online demos, webinars), with technical inputs, formulation discussions and follow-up.
* Join sales on market visits to brand owners, contract manufacturers and trade partners to understand requirements and opportunities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting to customers on formulation, stability, processing and performance issues – identify root causes and recommend corrective solutions.

7. Documentation

* Maintain accurate lab notebooks, formulation records, batch sheets and test reports.
* Prepare technical data sheets, formulation brochures, application notes and product dossiers with full traceability.
* Support sales and principals with technical documents, test data, certificates and customer queries.
* Support regulatory and compliance documentation (SDS, claims support, BIS, ISO 22716/GMP).
* Support sampling: prepare, label, pack and dispatch samples; track requests, feedback and conversions.
* Manage the formulation database, sample inventory and retention-sample library.

8. Presentations and Technical Communication

* Deliver technical presentations to customers, internal teams and principals, covering formulation results and project updates.
* Present case studies and performance data with clear visuals.
* Develop product application training for sales teams.
* Work with marketing on digital campaigns (webinars, e-mailers, social media, online content) and promotional material (brochures, flyers, application videos, case studies), ensuring technical accuracy.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Pharm / M.Pharm in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Oils & Surfactants, Chemical or Pharmaceutical Technology.

**Experience**

* Senior Executive: 3–6 years; Assistant Manager: 6–10 years in personal care formulation (skin and hair care), in a lab, application or R&D role – preferably with a raw material supplier or distributor.
* Hands-on experience in emulsions, surfactant systems, sun care and hair care.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, INCI, stability and regulatory basics.
* Excellent presentation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; formulation software is a plus.
* Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Collaborative, curious and innovative; willing to travel for trade shows and customer visits.

Works closely with Personal Care and Home Care sales and marketing, principals' technical teams, customers, and regulatory and quality functions.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Fermentation & Upstream Processing
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves managing and optimizing upstream manufacturing operations, including microbial fermentation, media preparation, inoculum development, and microbial algae cultivation. The role focuses on overseeing day-to-day production activities, optimizing fermentation parameters, improving biomass productivity, and ensuring consistent batch performance while meeting production targets and quality standards. The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day upstream manufacturing operations, including media preparation, sterilization, inoculum development, fermentation, and microbial algae cultivation.
* Supervise and monitor fermentation processes to ensure consistent biomass growth, product yield, and adherence to production schedules.
* Operate and oversee fermenters, bioreactors, seed vessels, media preparation systems, sterilization systems, and associated auxiliary equipment.
* Support upstream production of microbial biomass for the manufacture of omega oils, including DHA and EPA, derived from microbial algae.
* Monitor and optimize critical process parameters such as temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, agitation, aeration, nutrient feed, and fermentation duration.
* Perform media optimization, inoculum optimization, and process parameter optimization based on strain performance and production requirements.
* Troubleshoot fermentation-related issues, identify root causes of process deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure proper execution of batch manufacturing activities, including batch documentation, process monitoring, yield tracking, and timely batch completion.
* Take responsibility for the successful execution of assigned batches, ensuring process consistency, productivity, and compliance with established specifications.
* Support process development, technology transfer, and scale-up activities from laboratory or pilot scale to commercial manufacturing scale.
* Coordinate with downstream processing teams to ensure the timely transfer of fermentation broth or biomass for subsequent extraction and purification operations.
* Collaborate with quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to address process deviations, equipment breakdowns, and operational challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, safety protocols, hygiene standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch manufacturing records, equipment logbooks, and other relevant documentation.
* Monitor raw material and media requirements, coordinate procurement planning with relevant departments, and minimize material wastage.
* Assist in production planning, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and resource utilization to achieve manufacturing targets within the approved budget.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, increased biomass productivity, improved fermentation yields, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Lead and guide upstream production personnel, ensuring adherence to operating procedures, safety practices, and quality standards.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, automation systems, and process improvements in upstream manufacturing.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
* Duties and responsibilities are not limited to the work listed above and may include other assignments as necessary

Qualifications, Competencies, and Position Requirements

* Strong technical knowledge of upstream bioprocessing, microbial fermentation, and bioreactor operations.
* Practical understanding of microbial algae cultivation and fermentation-based production of omega oils, particularly DHA and/or EPA, is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of media formulation, inoculum development, sterilization, aseptic techniques, and fermentation process control.
* Ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize critical process parameters to improve biomass productivity and product yield.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, process deviation management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Familiarity with GMP, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, and industrial safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple production activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including night shifts, as required.
* Willingness to travel as required by the role.

***Education and Experience:***

* M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Biotechnology.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience in upstream manufacturing, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess operations, preferably in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food biotechnology, or microbial oil industry.
* Hands-on experience in industrial-scale fermentation, bioreactor operations, media optimization, and process parameter optimization is preferred.
* Exposure to microbial algae cultivation and the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, is desirable.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, process troubleshooting, and quality standards is preferred.

***Travel:***

Responsible for maintaining an effective Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality operations.

jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the programme. Ideate new research concepts with team members, develop project proposals and budgets, build relationships with donors that align with the institution’s interests, secure resources for building and expanding the work programme, deliver high-quality, timely outputs, engage with sectoral stakeholders, strive for impact, and develop CEEW’s thought leadership.
* Build and lead your team. Hone the team members to the best of their abilities. Stretch and strive and set leadership by initiative.
* Lead the strategic outreach of the programme. Lead external meetings, conferences, and seminars with government, political leadership, and public institutions, and be the face of CEEW in your programme area, while also creating platforms for your team for public engagement.
* Strategise the communication and outreach of research outputs along with the outreach team.
* Build strong relationships based on trust and credibility with key policymakers, political leadership, and sector stakeholders.

### **Selection Criteria and Key Skills**

* **Education:** PhD or Master’s degree in public policy/political science/international relations/ agriculture/rural development/food systems/public affairs/mass communication/journalism or any other relevant field relevant to food systems transformation.

### **Professional experience**

* At least 10 years of relevant experience in undertaking and leading research, policy engagement, and project management, in one or more of the following areas. Candidates who have prior experience in the following fields will be given a strong preference:
  + Political economy and public policy
  + Working in or with governments, political leadership, or public institutions
  + Agriculture, rural development, or food systems
  + Public affairs, strategic communications, or journalism, with an understanding of how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making
* Ability to navigate diverse stakeholders and strategise systems-level change
* Proven track record in building relationships and coalitions with government, political leadership, and public institutions
* Experience in designing and leading interdisciplinary and inter-programmatic work
* Strong track record of team management and project management, including timely delivery of outputs
* Have demonstrated thought leadership in the areas relevant to the ToR

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Curiosity and an ability to think creatively.
* Willingness to learn new research and project management skills.

* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.
* Ability to adapt to a new environment and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output.
* Ability to dig deeper into details, while also keeping a sense of the broader objectives and big picture.

### **Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by the industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**
