jobs.title: Quality Officer - Regulatory Affairs & Quality Compliance
jobs.description:
***ProV Foods is an integrated healthy foods conglomerate based in Mumbai, specializing in dry fruits and staples. With a focus on quality and affordability, ProV Foods offers a wide range of premium dry fruits, nuts, seeds, and spices. Every ProV product undergoes stringent quality controls to ensure the highest quality natural produce reaches our customers.***

*We are currently looking for a Quality Control Officer who have a specialization in* ***Regulatory Affairs & Quality Compliance*** *for our* ***Kopar Khairane Plant****.*

**Role Description:**

To manage and ensure regulatory compliance, packaging and labelling compliance, statutory licensing, production quality coordination and audit readiness across food manufacturing operations. The role involves ensuring adherence to FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety standards while supporting smooth business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, Food Safety and Standards Act, rules and regulations.
* Monitor regulatory amendments, notifications and updates and communicate their impact to relevant departments.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory and food safety requirements.
* Maintain regulatory documentation and compliance records.
* Coordinate with regulatory authorities and external agencies whenever required.

**2. Packaging & Labelling Compliance**

* Review and verify product labels, packaging artwork and declarations as per applicable FSSAI Labelling and Display Regulations and Legal Metrology requirements.
* Verify ingredient declarations, nutritional information, allergen declarations, additives, INS numbers, product claims, vegetarian/non-vegetarian logos, batch details, MRP, manufacturing details and other mandatory declarations.
* Coordinate with R&D, Marketing, Packaging and Design teams for new product launches and label approvals.
* Review packaging specifications and ensure regulatory compliance before implementation.
* Manage label changes arising from regulatory amendments.

**3. Licensing & Statutory Approvals**

* Handle FSSAI licensing and registration activities, including new applications, renewals, modifications and amendments.
* Coordinate for other applicable statutory licences, registrations and approvals.
* Ensure timely renewal and validity of all relevant licences and certificates.
* Maintain updated records of licences, approvals and statutory documents.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants for licensing-related activities.

**4. Production & Quality Coordination**

* Coordinate with production teams to ensure implementation of food safety, hygiene and quality requirements.
* Monitor GMP, GHP and operational compliance on the shop floor.
* Verify production records, process documentation and quality-related records.
* Ensure adherence to approved product specifications and manufacturing procedures.
* Identify compliance gaps during production activities and coordinate corrective actions.

**5. Audits & Certifications**

* Coordinate and participate in internal, external, customer and regulatory audits.
* Ensure audit preparedness through regular compliance checks and documentation reviews.
* Coordinate implementation of audit observations and closure of non-conformities.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support maintenance of applicable certifications such as FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, HACCP and other food safety certifications.

**6. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain regulatory, quality and audit-related documentation.
* Prepare compliance status reports and maintain trackers for licences, label approvals and audit observations.
* Ensure proper document control and timely updating of records.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely closure of compliance-related activities.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Good knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Practical experience in packaging and labelling compliance.
* Hands-on experience in FSSAI licensing activities.
* Understanding of food manufacturing and production processes.
* Experience in handling internal, external and customer audits.
* Good documentation, coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to independently identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Proficiency in MS Office and compliance documentation.

**Experience Requirements**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in the food manufacturing or FMCG industry.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in regulatory affairs, packaging and labelling, FSSAI licensing and food safety audits will be preferred.
* Experience in spices, seasonings, food ingredients or processed food manufacturing will be an added advantage.

**Note:** This is a plant level job hence 6 days a week occupancy will be required.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Mention your current CTC
* Mention your expected CTC

jobs.title: Lead Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

As a world market leader in crop protection, we help farmers to counter these threats and ensure enough safe, nutritious, affordable food for all – while minimizing the use of land and other agricultural inputs.

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Switzerland.

 **Job Description**

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**To support the strategic direction and achievement of business objectives of Syngenta in India, enhancing freedom to operate through building and maintaining Syngenta’s reputation externally.**

* To support the strategic direction and achievement of Syngenta’s business objectives in India by enhancing its freedom to operate, strengthening external reputation, and driving effective corporate affairs, government relations and public policy engagement.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing the regional Corporate Affairs strategy, translating regional priorities into India-specific action plans and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Develop and implement an India Corporate Affairs action plan in consultation with the Head of Corporate Affairs to support business objectives, ensure consistent engagement with key stakeholders, and strengthen Syngenta’s reputation in India.
* Work with business leaders and commercial unit heads to implement local and regional programs, ensuring disciplined and consistent internal and external communications, systematic stakeholder mapping, and effective stakeholder engagement.'

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Reputation Management, Governmental and Public Affairs**

* Develop a Corporate Affairs & Reputation Management action plan for India that supports the delivery of the regional corporate affairs strategy, and which is specific to the circumstances, issues and stakeholders in India. The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing regional Corporate Affairs strategies, priorities and programs, ensuring effective execution in India and alignment with regional objectives, business priorities and global reputation management frameworks.
* Support external communications and media relations in India in collaboration with appointed PR agencies, including communication planning, media engagement, press releases, media briefings and other external communication materials, ensuring consistency with Syngenta’s corporate positioning and messaging.
* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.
* Maintain regular dialogue on key issues with key government, industry and NGO contacts to ensure Syngenta’s position on key issues and our contribution to the management of these issues is well understood and accepted. Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.
* Lead and manage relationships with key State Agriculture stakeholders, including State Agriculture Departments, Agricultural Universities, Research Institutions, and state-level industry bodies, to support business priorities, policy advocacy, and stakeholder engagement objectives.
* Contributes to strengthening the organization’s technical knowledge of the regulatory and policy environment by effectively engaging with government ministries and regulatory authorities, while applying strong technical expertise to interpret and navigate registration requirements, processes, and compliance nuances.
* Responsible for securing and maintaining the License to Operate (LTO) and License to Produce (LPO) for the SIPL portfolio, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, regulatory compliance, and business continuity.
* Work with Regulatory Affairs managers to ensure a smooth transfer of existing government networks and contacts
* Provide inputs to the annual cycle of events associated with global reputation management, including inputs to the Annual Report, position papers, media releases and general events as they relate to South Asia
* Track Syngenta’s reputation across South Asia identifying key metrics and drivers and then establishing issues, themes and possible response strategies
* Ensure a consistent approach to reputation management through adoption of best practice common procedures and tools and sharing of best practices within business units

**Public Policy / Public Relations**

* Partners with non-government think tanks, state industry bodies, farmer networks, and NGOs to advance policy advocacy and reputation management objectives.

**Crisis Communications - EMS**

* Working with the Regional EMS Team, develop crisis communications plan as necessary to support corporate reputation in India

 **Qualifications**

**Critical Knowledge & Experience:**

* 15+ years of experience in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Public Policy, or Reputation Management within a multinational organization (agriculture, biotech, or allied sectors preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Public Policy, Law, Business Administration, or a related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of the Indian agriculture sector, regulatory landscape, and public policy environment.
* Proven experience engaging with Central and State Government stakeholders, industry associations, and regulatory authorities.
* Strong knowledge of regulatory processes, registrations, License to Operate (LTO), and License to Produce (LPO) requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to build, influence, and maintain relationships with senior external stakeholders.
* Strong government stakeholder relationship management and influencing skills.
* Experience in reputation management, policy advocacy, and issues management.
* At least 5 years of experience working with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams in Asia.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with full command of English.

**Critical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of regulatory and policy frameworks with the ability to navigate government processes and registration requirements
* Ability to work independently and build effective networks across stakeholders in India and within the organization.
* Strategic, analytical, creative and influencing skills.
* Leadership and team management skills, i.e. ability to build good relationships at all levels and to be able to advise, influence and coach.
* Proactive, self motivating, decisive, high level of crisis tolerance.
* Understanding complex change management and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Ability to communicate and interact within diverse environments (employees, influencers, customers, etc.).

**Other Behaviors, Critical for the role**:

Good team player. Interpersonal skills. Attention to detail; ability to find win-win solutions; ability to serve as a conduit in the flow of information between communications team and business units; flexibility in a fast-paced organization; ability to frequently measure the effectiveness of ongoing programs and adapt accordingly.

 **Additional Information**

**People are at the heart of what we do:**

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
SMC Agri Limited is a growing leader in the frozen fruits and vegetables processing industry, with five years of experience in contract manufacturing of frozen green peas. The company is expanding into a broader range of frozen fruits and vegetables, supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure and two high-capacity IQF lines. Its facility includes large-scale cold storage and an advanced effluent treatment plant, reflecting a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. SMC Agri Limited offers premium frozen products for retail, foodservice, and industrial clients, focusing on freshness, flavor, and nutritional value. The organization is driven by innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, providing a stable and forward-looking environment for professionals.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Cattle Feed Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based at the SMC Agri Limited facility in Sikandra Rao. The role involves analyzing raw materials and finished cattle feed for nutritional composition, quality, and safety using standardized laboratory methods and instruments. The analyst will develop and maintain feed formulations, ensure compliance with regulatory and internal quality standards, and prepare clear reports and documentation for internal stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include sampling, testing, data recording, trend analysis, and collaboration with procurement and production teams to optimize feed quality and cost. The role also requires participation in continuous improvement initiatives, maintaining laboratory hygiene and calibration records, and supporting audits and certifications related to feed quality.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong analytical and laboratory skills, including experience with sampling, chemical analysis, and use of basic lab instruments for feed or food testing.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of animal nutrition, feed formulation, and understanding of key parameters such as protein, fiber, moisture, and energy content.
* Candidates should possess competencies in quality assurance, documentation, and compliance with relevant standards and regulations in feed or food processing.
* Candidates should possess data handling skills, including basic statistics, record-keeping, and proficiency with spreadsheets or laboratory information systems.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with production, procurement, and quality teams, and to present findings clearly.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Science, Food Technology, or a related field is beneficial.
* Experience in feed mills, food processing, or agribusiness environments, and familiarity with safety, hygiene, and sustainability practices, will be an advantage.

**Job Category:**

Quality Laboratory Services
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Lab Analyst – Plant supports site‑level quality and food safety objectives by performing analytical, microbiological, physical, and application testing in accordance with established laboratory procedures. This role partners closely with plant quality, operations, and food safety teams to ensure accurate testing, reliable data, and compliance with food safety and quality requirements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Perform analytical, microbiological, physical, and application testing of raw materials, in‑process products, and finished goods following documented test methods and good laboratory practices.
* Support laboratory sample management activities, including receiving, logging, storing, and preparing samples for analysis.
* Review testing requests and coordinate daily workload with laboratory partners to meet production and quality timelines.
* Interpret, review, and verify laboratory data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with quality requirements.
* Prepare test reports, documentation, and records to support product release, investigations, and audits.
* Serve as a technical resource for plant quality and operations partners regarding laboratory results and testing methods.
* Evaluate laboratory processes, equipment, and procedures to support compliance and continuous improvement.
* Support laboratory investigations, including root cause analysis and corrective actions related to quality or food safety issues.
* Provide training and guidance to new laboratory partners and support field laboratory technical needs as required.
* Maintain laboratory safety, cleanliness, and organization in accordance with health, safety, and food safety policies.
* Support inventory management of laboratory supplies and reagents and place orders as needed.
* Support compliance with Food Safety and Food Quality Plans, including PCPs, CCPs, SOPs, and customer requirements.

What you will need to succeed
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific field (e.g., food science, microbiology, chemistry, biology).
* 3 to 5 years Laboratory experience in a food manufacturing, quality, or research environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of laboratory testing methods, good laboratory practices, and food safety principles.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a plant environment.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem‑solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including use of standard office software.
* Flexibility to work varied schedules, including weekends or extended hours, to support plant needs.

Job Title: Quality Analyst – Food, Dairy & Sweets Manufacturing

**Company:** Bikanervala  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Industry:** Food Processing, Dairy Products, Sweets & Confectionery

Job Summary

Bikanervala is looking for a dedicated and experienced Quality Analyst with practical knowledge of food quality control, dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, process control and regulatory compliance across food production and processing operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in dairy products, khoya/mawa, paneer, ghee, milk-based sweets and traditional Indian sweets, along with knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000 standards.

Key Responsibilities1. Raw Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials such as milk, cream, khoya, paneer, ghee, sugar, flour, besan, dry fruits, edible oils and other food ingredients.
* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Knowledge of khoya/mawa quality testing and moisture analysis.
* Experience in Brix testing using a refractometer.
* Knowledge of frying oil quality monitoring.
* Understanding of microbiological testing and shelf-life evaluation.
* Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis and internal quality audits.
* Good analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting abilities.

Important Practical Skills Required

Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* Milk quality testing and dairy product analysis.
* Khoya/Mawa quality inspection.
* Sugar syrup concentration testing (Brix).
* Moisture analysis of sweets and dairy products.
* Frying oil quality monitoring.
* Microbiological testing and hygiene monitoring.
* Shelf-life evaluation of dairy products and Indian sweets.
* Finished product sensory evaluation.
* Production-floor quality monitoring and batch inspection.
* Educational Qualification
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology.

Experience Required

* 1–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control.
* Experience in dairy, sweets, confectionery or food processing manufacturing will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Dairy Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Biotechnology with relevant food industry experience.
* Diploma in Food Processing or Dairy Technology with relevant practical experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant experience in Food Processing, Dairy and Indian Sweets Manufacturing can share their updated resumes or contact HR directly.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 43,000 employees.
  
  
**About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited**
***JubilantIngreviaisnowamemberoftheeliteGlobalLighthouseNetwork(GLN) oftheWorldEconomicForum(WEF)***
Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.
  
  
Ingrevia is born out of a union of ‘Ingredients’ and ‘Life’ (‘Vie’ in French). Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is committed to offering high-quality and innovative life science ingredients to enrich all forms of life.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia, a global integrated Life Science products and Innovative Solutions provider serving, Pharmaceutical, Nutrition, Agrochemical, Consumer and Industrial customers with our customised products and solutions that are innovative, cost-effective and conforming to excellent quality standards.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited offers a broad portfolio of high-quality ingredients that find application in a wide range of industries. Jubilant Ingrevia’s portfolio also extends to custom development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and agrochemical customers on an exclusive basis.
  
  
Ourbusinessissplitacross3businessverticals,withgloballeadership acrossourkeyproductlines.
  
  
***Speciality Chemicals:***
The Specialty Chemical business of Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures Pyridine, Picolines and its forward integration derivatives, which finds application in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes, solvents, metal finishes, fine chemicals, semiconductors etc.
  
  
We have also launched new platform of Diketene & its value-added derivatives for multiple industry use. We are an established ‘partner of choice’ in CDMO, with more investment plans in GMP & Non-GMP multi-product facilities for Pharma, Agro and Semi-conductor customers.
  
  
***Chemical Intermediates:***
The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.
  
  
***Nutrition & Health Solutions:***
The Nutrition & Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 & Picolinates (Chromium & Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high-quality feed & food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua & pet food industry. In Human Nutrition & Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients & premix solutions to nutrition.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in India. We practice world-class manufacturing processes in our day-to-day operations, assuring our customers with unmatched quality and timely delivery of products through innovations and cutting-edge technology. Transforming Manufacturing for Operational Excellence & Sustainability with “zero tolerance to any non-compliance” is the core focus of Jubilant Ingrevia Manufacturing.
  
  
We have 5 world-class manufacturing facilities i.e. One in UP at Gajraula, Two in Gujarat at Bharuch and Savli, Two in Maharashtra at Nira and Ambernath.
  
  
***Environment Sustainability***
The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.
  
  
Find out more about us at www.jubilantingrevia.com
  
  
**The Position**
**Organization : -**
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited
  
  
**Designation & Level: -**
Senior Research Scientist- Semi-Con.
  
  
**Location : -**
Corporate Greater Noida
  
  
**Reporting Manager: -**
Group Leader-CDMO
  
  

* Molecule Development:

+ Develop Electronic Grade products under strict contamination manner.
+ Utilize knowledge of multi-step synthesis and exposure to electronic industry.
+ Adhere to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) for sample preparation, impurity isolation, and characterization.

* Research and Optimization:

+ Conduct literature searches and route scouting for process development.
+ Develop processes at gram scale, scale up, and support plant for commercialization.
+ Prepare technology packages and synthesize impurities for isolation.
+ Perform studies on material of construction (MOC), effluent minimization, catalyst and solvent recyclability, and economization.
+ Prepare PFDs, P&IDs, mass balance, and equipment specifications for scale-up .

  
  
- Chemical Synthesis:

* Synthesize specialty as well as Electronic Grade chemicals and heterocyclic compounds.
* Demonstrate a good understanding of industrial feasibility, multi-step synthesis, electronic chemistry, impurity characterization, and data interpretation.

- Technical Expertise:

* Exposure to pressure reactions, innovative to handle product development at R&D followed with piloting and commissioning.
* Perform halogenation reactions such as chlorination, fluorination, Halex reaction, and bromination.
* Handle complex chemistries including Grignard, lithiation, cyclization, condensation, elimination, and reduction.
* Develop vapor phase and continuous processes.
* Safety & Compliance
* Maintain compliance with safety, ELN documentation etc.

**The Person**
**Qualifications & Experience:**

* PhD / MSc organic chemistry
* 7+ Years of Industrial Experience
* Hands on experience in process development, synthesis and lab scale up.

**What’s on Offer:**

* Opportunity to work with a leading company in the chemicals sector.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Career growth opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry

***Jubilant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, colour, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, political affiliation, race, ethnicity, religion or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.***

jobs.title: Principal Investigator - Process Engineer
jobs.description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Job Title: Principal Investigator – Process Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Process Development group at Innovation Center in Hyderabad works as part of an interdisciplinary team to design and develop synthetic routes for commercial manufacturing processes. Principal Investigator – Process Engineer will provide engineering support of all phases of process development, with responsibility from early stage to commercial launch.  This role includes conducting laboratory-based programs to develop commercial manufacturing processes as part of a cross-functional team of process chemists, analytical chemists and engineers, also partnering with third party Contract Research Organizations (CRO) to ensure pilot campaign success and extract engineering learnings to be used in future commercial manufacturing designs.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**The Role (daily Responsibilities)**

* Lead chemical engineering deliverables for assigned synthetic programs from early and/or late-stage development through process characterization, technology transfer, piloting, validation, and commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and oversee process engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), process descriptions, and detailed mass and heat balance calculations.
* Participate in rigorous risk assessments, HAZOP studies, failure-mode evaluations, and ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards.
* Provides subject matter expertise across development and scale-up, supporting technical package preparation, process and equipment fit assessment, scale-up strategies, facility readiness evaluations, technology transfer execution, validation activities, and post-transfer process stabilization.
* Provide strong technical leadership at CDMOs and manufacturing sites, including hands-on floor support, rapid troubleshooting, risk-based decision-making, issue escalation, and execution support during engineering, demonstration, pilot, and commercial campaigns.
* Build and maintain high-trust, high-accountability partnerships with external manufacturing partners by establishing clear governance, decision-making frameworks, communication pathways, performance expectations, and risk management processes.
* Lead or guide investigations, root-cause assessments, deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs, change controls, and process performance reviews using data-driven and science-based recommendations.
* Apply chemical engineering fundamentals, modeling, and manufacturing data to improve process capability, yield, purity, cycle time, safety, sustainability, productivity, and cost of goods.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and process simulation software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, Minitab, AutoCAD).
* Apply reaction engineering, thermodynamics, kinetics, heat and mass transfer, mixing, hydrodynamics, separations, filtration, drying, solid-liquid handling, and equipment design to development and manufacturing challenges.
* Create fit-for-purpose laboratory and engineering experiments, representative scale-down models, and process characterization studies that define mechanisms, operating ranges, robustness, and scale-up criteria.
* Integrate process safety, equipment and facility fit, material compatibility, containment, operability, maintainability, and human-factor considerations into process and technology-transfer decisions.
* Author, review, and defend engineering reports, technology-transfer packages, risk assessments, control strategy documents, technical investigations, and regulatory filing sections.
* Establish trusted relationships with CDMO leaders and technical teams while maintaining clear accountability, protecting FMC requirements, and addressing conflict or performance gaps directly and professionally.
* Distill complex technical information into concise recommendations, decision points, risks, and trade-offs for senior leaders, governance forums, regulatory stakeholders, and external partners.

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree or Ph.D in Chemical Engineering is required.
* Chemical engineers with a strong foundation in chemical engineering and organic chemistry, combined with hands-on experience in process development, pilot plant operations, and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* 7-15 years in R&D process development in agrochemicals, pharmaceutical, fine or specialty chemicals industry required.
* Familiarity with concepts of developing safe and cost-effective chemical processes.
* Strong organic chemistry knowledge is a plus.
* Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively and work in teams of scientists.
* The ability to effectively develop and test hypotheses and quickly determine the feasibility of a proposal is critical.
* Willingness to work flexibly across multiple time zones and travel as required, including primarily domestic travel and occasional international travel.
* Flexible work schedules to accommodate work performed in different geographies required.
* Experience working in kilo, pilot and/or manufacturing scale environments is desirable.

At FMC, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive – regardless of race, gender, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, color, age, religion or religious creed, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. FMC also supports employee participation in company employee resource groups that celebrate the diverse backgrounds of our workforce by providing communities for employees to connect with each other and raise awareness throughout FMC.  FMC complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Talent Acquisition department at talentacquisition@fmc.com.
  
  
FMC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. jobs.description:
🗂 We’re Hiring: Beverage Quality Manager | Beverage Production Technologist

🕒
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

💼
**Level:**
Mid-Level to Senior

We are seeking an experienced and technically skilled Beverage Quality Manager | Beverage Production Technologist to oversee beverage quality standards, optimize production processes, and ensure consistent product quality across manufacturing operations. This role focuses on managing quality control procedures, improving beverage formulation and production efficiency, monitoring food safety compliance, and implementing technical solutions to enhance product consistency, safety, and manufacturing performance.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement quality management procedures for beverage manufacturing and production operations.

• Oversee beverage production processes to ensure products meet established quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

• Monitor product formulation, ingredient specifications, processing conditions, and production consistency.

• Conduct quality inspections, laboratory testing, and product evaluations throughout the manufacturing process.

• Identify production defects, investigate quality issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality control guidelines, and production documentation.

• Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene standards, HACCP, GMP, and relevant industry requirements.

• Collaborate with production, research and development (R&D), procurement, and technical teams to improve manufacturing efficiency.

• Support beverage product development, formulation adjustments, and production trials.

• Monitor raw material quality, supplier specifications, packaging standards, and finished product performance.

• Analyze production data, quality reports, and laboratory results to identify improvement opportunities.

• Lead quality audits, production assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing facilities.

✅ Requirements

• Proven experience in beverage manufacturing, food technology, quality assurance, or production management.

• Strong understanding of beverage processing, formulation, manufacturing operations, and quality control systems.

• Knowledge of food safety standards, HACCP, GMP, and relevant beverage industry regulations.

• Experience with laboratory testing, product evaluation, quality inspections, and technical documentation.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to identify production inefficiencies and implement effective process improvements.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.

• Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS), production monitoring tools, and laboratory equipment is an advantage.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple production and quality priorities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Professional certifications in HACCP, ISO 22000, or food safety management are an advantage.

🌟 What We Offer

• Opportunity to oversee beverage quality management and production technology initiatives.

• Exposure to beverage innovation, manufacturing optimization, and advanced quality control processes.

• Opportunities to collaborate with production specialists, food scientists, and technical professionals.

• Career progression into Senior Quality Manager, Beverage Production Manager, Technical Operations Manager, Director of Quality Assurance, or Head of Manufacturing roles.

• A professional, collaborative, and technology-driven working environment.

• Training, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

✅ Who Can Apply?

• Currently residing in the UAE.

• Legally authorized to reside and work in the UAE.

• Tourist and visit visa holders are not eligible.

• Must have a personal UAE bank account to receive salary payments.

* • Previous professional experience is an advantage but not mandatory.

jobs.title: Chef De Cuisine at Waldorf Astoria Dubai International Financial Centre
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
A Chef de Cuisine at Waldorf Astoria Dubai International Financial Centre, a Forbes Five-Star luxury hotel, is responsible for leading the culinary vision and operations of Bull & Bear Restaurant with creativity, precision, and uncompromising attention to detail. The role is instrumental in delivering an exceptional and sophisticated dining experience that reflects the distinctive heritage and elevated standards of the Waldorf Astoria brand.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Responsibilities**
The Chef de Cuisine leads Bull & Bear Restaurant’s culinary operations, working closely with the Executive Chef and F&D Operations team to maintain high standards of quality, safety and efficiency, while driving culinary excellence and supporting the restaurant’s business objectives. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  
**Commercial Performance**

* Work with the Executive Chef to develop the kitchen’s business plan, considering market strategy, financial targets and business volumes, as well as customer and team member experience
* Review business results - including sales, food costs, profit margins, wastage, breakage, customer satisfaction - and take action with the restaurant management team to improve performance

**Excellent Food**

* Partner with the Executive Chef and F&D Operations team to create attractive F&D concepts, menus, products and promotions that drive revenue and profit
* Deliver delicious, high-quality, well-presented food to meet customers’ needs - and Instagram feeds!
* Support Hilton’s sustainability goals through local sourcing strategies, use of seasonal produce, minimizing food waste and efficient energy and water consumption.

**Exceptional Customer Experiences**

* Ensure the kitchen team prepare, present and deliver dishes on time, with pride and precision, to create exceptional customer experiences
* Make sure that food allergies, dietary requirements and customer modifications are treated with absolute seriousness and that all chefs are trained on correct food handling
* Review and act on customer feedback, taking prompt action to resolve customer complaints and improve loyalty

**Great Working Environment**

* Manage, develop and inspire the kitchen team, creating an inclusive environment where all Team Members can thrive and achieve their professional goals
* Practice great people management, from recruitment to training to succession planning and recognition
* Schedule Team Members’ working time efficiently based on forecast business volumes, offering flexibility where possible and minimizing overtime costs
* Communicate well and often, building good relationships with your team and key stakeholders.

**Day-To-Day Essentials**

* Make sure kitchen operations strictly comply with all regulations (including health, safety and hygiene, food safety certification, daily kitchen records and labelling) and that potentially hazardous situations are identified, reported and corrected.
* Work with the Purchasing team to select suppliers and control the quality of produce.
* Manage kitchen inventory, stock control and kitchen maintenance schedules, following hotel guidelines.
* Stay up-to-date with what’s happening in F&D – current and future trends, markets, ingredients, competitors and suppliers – to drive innovation.

**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
**Skills**
We’re looking for a Chef de Cuisine who is a passionate and experienced culinary leader, with at least three years of experience in a similar role and an internationally recognised culinary degree or diploma. Experience in menu development and a Steakhouse or luxury hospitality environment is essential. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the below skills and characteristics:
  
  

* Previous experience in a luxury hospitality environment in UAE.
* Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to contribute to business performance, manage costs and achieve operational targets.
* Inspirational leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead, develop, motivate and engage a diverse culinary team.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with team members, suppliers and other key stakeholders.
* A strong customer focus, with a commitment to delivering exceptional food quality, presentation, consistency and hygiene standards.
* Proven menu development skills, with the creativity and culinary expertise to develop innovative and commercially successful concepts.
* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and focused.
* A passion for culinary excellence and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of food production and guest experience.
* Confidence using F&D systems and Microsoft Office.

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:
  
  

* Experience working in a Forbes-rated luxury hospitality environment and a strong understanding of Forbes Travel Guide Standards.

**What will it be like to work for Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts?**
Waldorf Astoria provides guests the exceptional environment and the personalized attention of True Waldorf Service that creates a singular experience. If you understand the value of personalized attention and know how to treat even the most extraordinarily different experiences with the same rich level of customer service, you may just be the person we are looking for!
  
  
**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
The Head Chef at Rosa's Thai Restaurant will lead all kitchen operations and drive culinary excellence across the brand. This role is responsible for delivering authentic, high-quality Thai cuisine, maintaining operational standards, managing food cost and kitchen performance, and leading a high-performing culinary team. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership, deep knowledge of Thai or Asian cuisine, and experience managing high-volume kitchens.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Menu Development: Lead the creation and refinement of authentic Thai dishes aligned with the brand's concept, ensuring consistency, innovation, and authenticity.
* Kitchen Leadership & Supervision: Oversee daily kitchen operations, guiding Sous Chefs and kitchen staff to ensure efficiency, discipline, and consistent execution.
* Food Preparation & Presentation: Ensure all dishes meet the highest standards of taste, texture, and presentation.
* Service & Ticket Time Management: Monitor service flow and ticket preparation times, particularly during peak hours.
* Quality Assurance, Health & Safety: Conduct and manage QA/QC, health & safety, and operational audits in compliance with company standards and local regulations.
* Inventory & Cost Control: Manage inventory, par levels, wastage, and food cost to optimize profitability and minimize loss.
* Recipe Training & Execution: Train kitchen staff on recipes, techniques, portioning, and presentation to ensure consistency.
* Hygiene & Food Safety: Enforce strict food safety and hygiene standards, maintaining a clean and compliant kitchen at all times.
* Creativity & Innovation: Encourage creative thinking while respecting the core principles of Thai cuisine.
* Team Development: Mentor and develop kitchen staff, fostering a positive, collaborative, and disciplined work culture.
* Events & Catering: Plan and execute menus for special events, private dining, and catering, including dietary requirements.
* Budget Management: Work closely with management on kitchen budgeting, cost control, and resource planning.
* Kitchen Cleanliness & Maintenance: Ensure cleanliness, organization, and proper equipment maintenance.
* FOH Collaboration: Coordinate closely with Front-of-House teams to ensure smooth service and guest satisfaction.
* Food Quality Review: Review customer feedback and implement corrective action plans where required.
* Adaptability & Composure: Handle operational changes and service pressure calmly and professionally.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on culinary trends and continuously enhance menu offerings and kitchen performance.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Proven experience managing a kitchen specializing in Thai or Asian cuisine.
* Strong background in authentic Thai/Wok cooking techniques, ingredients, and flavors.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, train, and motivate kitchen teams.
* Prior experience in high-volume restaurant kitchens is highly preferred.
* Solid understanding of food safety, hygiene, and regulatory compliance.
* Ability to innovate while maintaining culinary authenticity.
* Strong organizational skills with experience managing food cost and wastage.
* Effective communicator with kitchen teams, management, and FOH.
* Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Formal culinary education or certifications are an advantage but not mandatory.

**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Director - Product Development to lead the development, qualification, industrialization, and delivery of a portfolio of SATCOM products, including advanced antenna systems, modems, and integrated terminals.
  
  
The role will provide overall product, engineering, and industrial leadership across the complete product lifecycle, from product strategy, technology selection, and requirements definition through design, integration, verification, qualification, production readiness, and manufacturing ramp-up. The Director will ensure products achieve the required performance, quality, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and reliability objectives, while driving product maturity, localization, and continuous improvement throughout the lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the product development and industrialization strategy for the SATCOM product portfolio, including antennas, modems, and integrated terminals.
* Provide leadership, direction, and mentoring to multidisciplinary product, engineering, manufacturing, integration, and test teams.
* Establish product roadmaps and development priorities aligned with Space42 Technology group, customer needs, business objectives, technology evolution, and market requirements.
* Oversee products through the complete lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design reviews, integration, qualification, acceptance, production readiness, and product release.
* Ensure effective governance of product requirements, technical baselines, interfaces, configuration, risks, and engineering changes.
* Lead industrialization activities, including manufacturing strategy, production-line setup, process definition, tooling, test systems, supply-chain readiness, and production ramp-up.
* Drive design for manufacturability, assembly, testability, reliability, quality, and cost across the product portfolio.
* Coordinate antenna, RF, modem, FPGA, electronics, mechanical, thermal, embedded software, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, and test functions.
* Manage technical execution with suppliers, technology partners, subcontractors, and contract manufacturers, including deliverables, dependencies, compliance, risks, and milestones.
* Support supplier selection, technology-transfer, localization, make-or-buy, and industrial-partnership decisions.
* Provide regular portfolio, product, technical, industrialization, cost, schedule, and risk updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Drive product maturity, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and lessons learned across development and production

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunications, RF/Microwave, Aerospace, Systems, or Industrial Engineering; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in SATCOM, aerospace, defense, telecommunications, or high-reliability product development, including at least 8 years in senior engineering, product, or industrial leadership.
* Proven experience leading the development and industrialization of complex SATCOM products, preferably including antennas, modems, terminals, or related communication systems.
* Strong understanding of SATCOM systems and products, including antenna systems, RF architectures, modems, digital communications, networking, embedded hardware, software, FPGA, and system integration.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams through requirements definition, development, integration, qualification, acceptance, industrialization, and product release.
* Strong experience in manufacturing readiness, production-line setup, process development, tooling, test systems, quality controls, supply-chain readiness, and production ramp-up.
* Good understanding of DFM, DFA, DFT, configuration management, product qualification, reliability, cost optimization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with suppliers, technology partners, and contract manufacturers, including RFI/RFP/RFQ evaluations, technical due diligence, negotiations, and performance management.
* Experience with technology transfer, localization, intellectual-property considerations, and establishing local engineering or manufacturing capabilities is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate product strategies and complex technical dependencies into executable development, industrialization, resource, cost, and delivery plans.
* Strong leadership, commercial awareness, engineering judgment, and risk-management capabilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including customer, supplier, partner, and executive-level interactions.
* Strong focus on product quality, manufacturability, delivery performance, cost competitiveness, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

**About Us**
Space42 (ADX: SPACE42) is a UAE-based AI-powered SpaceTech company that integrates satellite communications, geospatial analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities to enlighten the Earth from space. Established in 2024 following the successful merger between Bayanat and Yahsat, Space42’s global reach allows it to address the rapidly evolving needs of its customers in governments, enterprises, and communities.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

The Project Lead runs JOMARA's new product development (NPD) and commercial execution projects from first idea to delivery on shelf. You will own the plan for every new product, new and seasonal packaging, supermarket planograms and trade show participation. You will coordinate internal teams, suppliers and retail partners so every launch lands on time, on budget and to JOMARA's premium standard.

**Key Accountabilities:**

New Product Development (NPD)

* Lead NPD projects end-to-end: concept, product brief, development and sampling, costing, approvals, production trial and launch.
* Run a stage-gate process with clear milestones, owners and sign-offs at each step.
* Coordinate Production, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales and Finance throughout each project.
* Make sure every product meets labelling, shelf-life, certification (organic, halal, food safety) and market import requirements.
* Track performance after launch and feed lessons into the next project.
* Forecasting and planning along with the supply chain

**Packaging Development (new and seasonal)**

* Manage new packaging and redesign projects from brief to delivered stock: agency briefing, artwork, proofs, approvals, printing and supplier lead times.
* Plan and deliver seasonal and gifting packaging (Ramadan, Eid, Hajj & Umrah, National Day, year-end and international festive seasons) on a calendar that works back from in-store dates.

* Build new listings and range changes into planograms together with Sales and merchandising teams.
* Run store checks on planogram compliance, share of shelf, pricing and visibility; report gaps and corrective actions.

* Manage the full trade show checklist: registration, stand design and build, samples and shipments, marketing materials, logistics, travel and visas, staffing, lead capture and post-show follow-up.

* NPD and packaging projects delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
* Seasonal packaging in stores by the agreed date for every season.
* Planogram compliance and share of shelf in key supermarket accounts.
* Trade show checklists completed on time; leads generated and converted.

* Background in FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods.
* Hands-on experience launching products, customers or markets (export or international expansion preferred).

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Us**
talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real-time tracking and payments.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
  
  
We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat

**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days**
: You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
  
  
**By 6 months**
: Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
  
  
**By 12 months**
: You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**You must have**

* 6+ years of hands-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross-platform)
* 2+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade-offs between native vs cross-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data

**Bonus If You Have**

* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or event-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

**This role is for you if...**

* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought

**This role is NOT for you if...**

* You want a pure people-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices

**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
  
  
**Engineering Manager**
— You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager**
— You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
  
  
**Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company-wide technical strategy, build director-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.
