jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatician
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a multidisciplinary genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for independently leading complex bioinformatics and human genetics analyses, applying robust analytical methodologies, and introducing innovative tools and approaches that enhance the organization's scientific and technical capabilities. The position contributes to translational research, scientific discovery, and publication activities through the analysis of large-scale genomic and phenotype-linked datasets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and execution of bioinformatics analyses on large-scale human genomic datasets, including whole genome sequencing (WGS) data.
* Perform genomic analyses including variant discovery, genotype-phenotype analysis, population genetics, association studies, rare variant analysis, ancestry-aware analysis, and family-based genomic investigations.
* Analyze and interpret genomic findings within the context of human genetics, population structure, clinical phenotypes, and scientific evidence.
* Assess data quality, analytical assumptions, biases, and limitations to ensure scientific rigor and reproducibility.
* Integrate genomic, clinical, and phenotype data to support translational and clinically relevant research.
* Develop, optimize, and implement bioinformatics workflows, pipelines, and analytical methodologies.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, datasets, and analytical approaches and introduce appropriate innovations to enhance team capabilities.
* Collaborate with bioinformaticians, scientists, clinicians, researchers, and technical teams to deliver cross-functional research objectives.
* Contribute to scientific publications, manuscripts, technical reviews, presentations, and conference activities.
* Communicate analytical methods, results, risks, assumptions, and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, data governance standards, and scientific best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance analytical quality, operational efficiency, and scientific outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Human Genetics, Genomics, Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Extensive experience in human genomics, bioinformatics, computational biology, or biomedical data science.
* Proven experience independently leading complex genomic analysis projects.
* Experience working with large-scale genomic datasets and whole genome sequencing data.
* Strong scientific publication record preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or R.
* Hands-on experience with bioinformatics tools such as PLINK, REGENIE, bcftools, VCFtools, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of human genetics, population genomics, variant analysis, and genotype-phenotype relationships.
* Experience with clinical, phenotype, or longitudinal healthcare datasets is advantageous.
* Knowledge of OMOP, FHIR, EHR-derived phenotypes, or healthcare data standards is desirable.
* Experience with machine learning, artificial intelligence, or large language model applications in genomics is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

We are seeking an Applied Biotechnology and Reproduction Researcher to develop and oversee fundamental, physiological, and applied research and reproductive biotechnology projects mainly for threatened wildlife.

The role spans reproductive physiology, gamete and embryo technologies, cell-based approaches, and translating promising methods into conservation breeding practice. Working closely with veterinary, breeding and external research teams, the researcher will translate scientific findings into methods that support conservation breeding programmes across species.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and lead research projects in reproductive physiology, assisted reproduction, gamete and embryo biology, and related cell technologies.
* Develop and optimise methods for artificial insemination, cryopreservation, cell culture and genome resource banking.
* Assess the feasibility of in vitro fertilisation (IVF), embryo production and culture, and somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT), where biologically appropriate.
* Design experiments, troubleshoot protocols, analyse results and maintain accurate, reproducible research records.
* Collaborate with veterinary and breeding teams to assess how research methods can be applied within operational conservation programmes.
* Coordinate research collaborations with external scientific partners.
* Prepare scientific publications and communicate research findings to relevant teams.

**Required Qualifications:**

* PhD in reproductive biology, veterinary or animal sciences, developmental biology, biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.
* Substantial research experience in reproductive physiology, assisted reproduction, gamete or embryo biology, reproductive cryobiology, or related cell technologies.
* Publication records relevant to the research areas covered by the role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading experimental research projects.
* Practical expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as gamete and embryo technologies, artificial insemination, cryopreservation or cell culture.
* Strong skills in experimental design, data analysis, protocol development and scientific documentation.
* Ability to coordinate collaborators and work effectively with scientific, veterinary and breeding teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, for reporting, data organisation and presentations.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis software and scientific data management tools.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to write scientific reports and communicate with international research partners.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Research experience with wildlife, threatened species or non-model species.
* Experience supporting operational conservation breeding programmes.
* Direct experience in IVF, embryo production and culture, embryo transfer, intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), SCNT or related cloning approaches.
* Experience in genome resource banking.
* Experience mentoring postgraduate students or junior researchers.

Based in Reneco’s Research Division in Abu Dhabi, the researcher will identify scientific priorities, develop research projects, and oversee studies conducted internally, by students, and through external collaborations. The role involves close collaboration with the Veterinary Division to address animal health challenges and translate research findings into practical recommendations.

* Identify knowledge gaps and propose veterinary research projects aligned with conservation, animal health and breeding priorities.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.description:
Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 1)   

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.  
**Audit Execution**  
•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.  
•    Develop process understanding of assigned business processes and determines business objectives, main functions, the nature of activities, potential risks and controls to be reviewed.Develop a detailed audit program / Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) for the assigned audit including the objectives, potential risk, key controls, audit procedures and the use of audit techniques and tools to evaluate governance, risks and controls processes, and submits audit program to for review and approval.  
•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.  
•    Participate in conducting special reviews and undertakes administrative duties as directed by Head of Internal Audit.  
•    Perform (also supervises audits performed by Internal Auditors) in accordance with the approved RACM and professional standards on internal auditing.  
•    Ensures tasks assigned to junior staff are adequately performed and deliverables are in accordance with ADNOC Internal Audit procedures and quality standards.  
•    Identify high risk areas and key control points of the system to be reviewed.  
•    Evaluate the system’s effectiveness based on his / her business and audit experience and modifies, if necessary, the scope of the review, with the approval of Team Leader / Department Manager.  
•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 2)   

**Audit Reports**  
•    Prepare audit report with conclusion, expressing professional opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management, control systems and the efficiency with which activities are carried out. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.  
•    Recommend practical improvements options corresponding to the observations with an objective to contribute to the improvement of governance, risks and control processes to assist in the achievement of the company business objectives.  
•    Follow- up on replies to issued draft and final audit reports and review the adequacy of the corrective actions taken on audit recommendations / improvement options.  
**Coordination**  
•    Assist Audit Management in arranging Audit Committee meetings, preparing the agenda, and minutes of meetings (MOMs) and reporting on Corporate Governance Framework, General Controls and other related issues as prescribed in the Audit Committee Charter.   
•    Conducts workshops or presentations to create awareness about IA function and demonstrate value addition across the ADNOC.  
•    Communicates identified issues with Internal Audit management to ensure potential high risk area of concerns are addressed in a timely and effective manner.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Participate in the development and implementation of the automated Audit Management System.  
•    Provide professional advice on Group Companies’ Audit Committee Charter,   
**IA Charter and IA Methodology/Procedures. Provides assistance in the establishment of the Group Audit Committees/IA functions and related governance, when assigned.**  
•    Participate in initiating and coordinating the Group-wide specialized professional training programs.   
•    Conducts research and benchmarking to resolve audit issues, identify gaps and support IA function.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 3)   
  
Generic Accountabilities   

**Supervision**  
•    Plan, supervise and coordinate all activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.  
•    Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective section objectives.  
**Budgets**  
•    Provide input for preparation of the Section / Department budgets and assist in the implementation of the approved Budget and work plans to deliver Section objectives.   
•    Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control  
**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures**  
•    Implement approved Section / Department policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the Section’s / Department work programs in line with Company and International standards.  
**Performance Management**  
•    Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Section / Department in line with the Company Performance framework.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.  
•    Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with ISO standards in order to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.  
**Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability**  
•    Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures & controls and applicable legislation and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.  
**Reports**  
•    Provide inputs to prepare Section MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

  
  
  
Generic Accountabilities (continue)   
  
Internal Communications & Working Relationships   

•    Regular Contacts with operational level management within all auditable departments throughout ADNOC.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to manage the day-to-day accounting activities of our retail operations. The role covers purchase reconciliation, inventory accounting, accounts payable, and monthly closing, ensuring accurate records and timely insights for management

  
  

**What Did We Order**

  
  

* Record daily, weekly and monthly journal entries, including purchase, petty cash and store expenses.
* Execute high-volume payment and supplier statement reconciliations across accounts payable, resolving discrepancies to maintain on-time payment schedules.
* Managing the receiving the inventory and credit note with the invoice matching and handling the issue with the operation team
* Reconcile purchases, supplier invoices and bank payments, and investigate discrepancies.
* Manage accounts payable and supplier statement reconciliations; process payments on schedule.
* Support the line manager with monthly closing, accruals, prepayments and fixed-asset depreciation entries.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules and supporting documents.

jobs.title: Audit Supervisor
jobs.description:

 The Audit Supervisor will be responsible for the planning, execution, supervision and completion of audit engagements for a diverse portfolio of UAE clients.

Qualification

  
  

ACCA Affiliate, ACCA Member or equivalent internationally recognised professional accounting qualification.

  
  

Experience

* UAE audit experience will be a strong advantage.

* Technically strong and detail-oriented.
  
* Capable of taking ownership of an audit engagement.
  
* Comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  
* Confident in communicating directly with clients.

jobs.title: Sales Governance & Control Senior Officer

Job Purpose

•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.

•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Aquaculture Manager

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Aquaculture Manager to oversee aquaculture operations through remote performance monitoring, production data analysis, technical documentation review, resource planning, and virtual coordination. The role focuses on improving production efficiency, supporting aquatic animal health and welfare programs, monitoring water quality trends, and strengthening operational standards across aquaculture facilities.

The successful candidate will collaborate with farm managers, aquaculture technicians, aquatic animal health specialists, and qualified local personnel to review operational performance, identify production risks, and recommend improvements. This is a fully remote management and advisory position; it does not involve direct physical farm operations or replace locally required technical supervision.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and monitor aquaculture production strategies, operational targets, and performance improvement plans.
* Review production reports covering stocking density, growth rates, feed conversion ratios, survival rates, biomass, and harvest performance.
* Analyze water quality data, including dissolved oxygen, temperature, pH, salinity, ammonia, and other relevant parameters.
* Evaluate feeding strategies, feed utilization, stock management practices, and production efficiency.
* Review aquatic animal health records, mortality trends, disease surveillance reports, and biosecurity documentation.
* Coordinate remotely with farm managers, aquaculture technicians, suppliers, and technical consultants.
* Monitor compliance documentation relating to aquaculture operations, environmental management, animal welfare, and resource utilization.
* Assess production risks and recommend improvements to farm management procedures, biosecurity controls, and operational planning.
* Review records relating to hatchery performance, broodstock management, juvenile production, stocking schedules, and harvesting plans.
* Analyze inventory, feed consumption, equipment performance records, and operating costs to support resource planning.
* Prepare management dashboards, production forecasts, operational summaries, and performance reports.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives involving sustainable aquaculture, water efficiency, waste reduction, and responsible production practices.
* Coordinate virtual technical meetings, operational reviews, training sessions, and follow-up actions.
* Maintain accurate digital records, standard operating procedures, technical reports, and management documentation.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Aquaculture, Fisheries Science, Marine Biology, Aquatic Animal Science, or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in aquaculture management, fish or shrimp farming, hatchery operations, or aquatic production systems.
* Strong understanding of aquaculture production cycles, stocking management, feeding practices, and water quality requirements.
* Experience analyzing production indicators, survival rates, growth performance, feed conversion, and operational costs.
* Familiarity with aquatic animal health monitoring, biosecurity procedures, disease surveillance, and environmental management.
* Knowledge of recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), pond-based farming, cage culture, hatchery systems, or other relevant production methods.
* Strong analytical, planning, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in digital farm management platforms, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and remote collaboration systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate geographically distributed teams and manage multiple operational priorities independently.
* Professional aquaculture, fisheries, or aquatic animal health certifications are advantageous.

What We Offer

* 100% remote working arrangement from home.
* Full-time employment opportunity in a professional and collaborative environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to sustainable aquaculture development and production improvement.
* Exposure to diverse aquaculture systems, technical performance monitoring, and operational management initiatives.
* Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary and international teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant aquaculture management experience, production systems knowledge, technical expertise, and professional qualifications.

**Application Subject:**
Application – Aquaculture Manager (UAE Remote)

Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

**Important Scope Clarification:**
This position is fully remote and focuses on production data analysis, technical oversight, documentation review, operational planning, and virtual coordination. Physical fish or shrimp handling, feeding, stocking, harvesting, water sampling, laboratory testing, equipment operation, facility inspections, and on-site farm supervision must be performed by trained and qualified local personnel. Veterinary diagnosis, treatment decisions, disease-control directives, animal welfare determinations, environmental approvals, regulated aquaculture authorizations, formal certifications, and statutory sign-offs must be handled by appropriately licensed or authorized professionals.

Miral Experiences is a region’s leader in the management and operation of world-class, award-winning immersive attractions and experiences across Abu Dhabi. We specialize in crafting unique experiences that cater to all tastes and ages, delivering a seamless blend of thrills, joy, and discovery. Our attractions are designed to ignite the imagination and create unforgettable memories for visitors from around the world. Whether you're seeking excitement, relaxation, or cultural enrichment, we offer something for everyone.

**About the Role**

The Senior Research Technician – Marine Ecology is responsible for managing the routine and non-routine technical operations to the Marine Ecology laboratory under the direct leadership of the senior researchers – marine ecology. He/she is responsible for the execution of daily operations and maintenance of the YSWRRC Experimental wet lab facility.

The Research Technician’s main responsibilities are:

* Managing protocols and care for animal and plant research subjects
* Assisting the research team in the implementation of research projects
* Developing and managing complementary research projects
* Performing routine maintenance on facility, systems and equipment
* Providing work direction and training for technicians and student researchers
* Collecting, interpreting, describing and documenting data to support research activities
* Managing scientific databases

**Key Responsibilities**

**Management of cultures and care of research subjects and systems**

* Manages the routine operations of the marine ecology experimental facility, including systems maintenance, water exchange, cleaning tasks and technician schedule
* Manages the husbandry operations of animals/plants present in the laboratory (depending on project including reef fishes, corals, other invertebrates, and seagrass), including feeding and health monitoring
* Leads the breeding and larval rearing of tropical marine fishes and invertebrates for the marine ecology laboratory
* Develops and makes suggestions for improvements to the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and practices which promote high-quality operation of the facility
* Manages all records as required in the SOPs
* Liaises with appropriate teams to maintain health of the cultures, animals as well as the functioning of the systems to the level expected for the research projects

**Support of the research program**

* Assists the ecology team with the design, development, and maintenance of experimental set-ups as required by the research project methodologies and/or directed by the senior researcher
* Sets up and performs research experiments and procedures following prescribed protocol with autonomy (this may include weekend or night-time work
* Develops and manages complementary research projects
* Support with sample processing and data analysis
* Operates field, office, laboratory, and/or shop equipment used in support of research projects
* Collects, interprets, describes, and documents complex analytical and evaluative research data
* Manages data and databases
* Prepares reports, analyses, and basic models identifying progress and trends; makes recommendations or conclusions
* Provides technical aspects for a variety of research project components
* Provides technical training to visiting scientists and university students
* Assists research team with field work

**Management of the marine ecology laboratory and systems maintenance**

* Organizes and maintains and maintains aquarium systems, tools, equipment and grounds
* Monitors supply and equipment inventory to sustain day-to-day operations
* Assists with the maintenance of dry lab facilities (e.g., microscopes, spectrophotometer, Flowcam, nutrient analyzer).

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the rescue operations when required
* Leads the research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRR projects by performing all other duties as assigned

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., animal science, biology, microbiology, aquaculture)
* 4 years of experience as technician in a marine research or aquaculture facility or aquarium
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Experience in marine ecological research in an aquarium and/or experimental setting
* Demonstrated competency in aquaculture operations including breeding, hatchery and larval rearing methodologies
* Good computer skills, including solid competencies using Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to community, media, government agencies, and conservation associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills and teamwork abilities
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* Degree in Marine Ecology or Marine Biology
* 2 years of experience in a marine ecology research institute
* 2 years of experience with coral and/or seagrass husbandry.
* Arabic verbal and written communication skills
* Previous experience in the GCC region
* Evidence of ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research teams
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

**Shape the Future with Us**

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.
